p.d: Die großen Pflanzenfresser der Serengeti, darunter Elefanten, Gnus, Büffel und Giraffen, ziehen immer auf der Suche nach saftigen Weidegründen umher. Ihre Wanderungen sind spektakulär. Sie sind die mächtigen Vegetarier der Savanne: Gnus.

Kristallklare Seen, schroffe Gipfel und urige Almen hat das Berchtesgadener Land. Es zählt zu den beliebtesten Reisezielen Deutschlands. Die Region lockt mit spektakulärer Naturkulisse, tief verwurzelten Bräuchen und besonderen Menschen.

Uli, inzwischen mit Vreneli verheiratet, ist Vater eines Töchterchens. Er hat den Glunggenhof in Pacht; Joggeli bewohnt mit seiner Frau das Stöckli. Der hundertjährige Kalender prophezeit ein schlechtes Jahr. Tatsächlich fällt die Ernte so dürftig aus, dass Uli am liebsten auf die Zahlung verzichten würde. Doch Vreneli stimmt ihn um. Pünktlich zum Zinstag finden sich auf der Glungge Joggelis Sohn Johannes und der Tochtermann aus Basel ein, um ihren Anteil von der Pacht einzusacken.

Im Waadtländer Jura rund um den Lac de Joux leben Menschen, die Natur und Tradition tief verbunden sind. Hier trotzt man Wind und Wetter mit Passion und Herz. Es ist ein Ort wie aus der Zeit gefallen. Wer einmal da war, kehrt immer wieder zurück.

Die Brüder Bernhard und Hannes treffen sich nach Jahren anlässlich der Beerdigung ihrer Schwester in Oberbayern wieder. Beide wollen ihren elterlichen Bauernhof, den die Schwester führte, schnellstmöglich veräußern, um wieder ihrer Wege gehen zu können. Doch ihre junge Nichte möchte das Land zum Biohof umfunktionieren und steckt mit ihrem Enthusiasmus auch ihre beiden Onkel an. Doch der intrigante Kundenberater der örtlichen Bank versucht, das Unternehmen zu sabotieren.

Ein Dorf im Mühlviertel um die Jahrhundertwende: Der ermordete Großbauer Hillinger hat seinen Hof seinen sieben Knechten und Mägden vermacht. Während die Siebtelbauern lernen, frei und selbstverantwortlich zu leben, wächst die Feindseligkeit der alteingesessenen Bauernschaft gegen die jungen, herrenlosen Dienstleute und deren Anführer Lukas.

Zwei Bauern mit Pioniergeist haben etwas Ungewöhnliches gewagt, sie haben stillgelegte Almen wieder zum Leben erweckt. Vor sieben Jahren machte sich der junge Allgäuer Christian Schratz an die Arbeit und arbeitete die brachliegende Gehrenalpe auf.

Eine Sennerin in der Steiermark, ein Schafbauer in Osttirol und ein Hirte in Vorarlberg geben Einblick in ein Leben, das von der Schönheit der Landschaft und von einer traditionsreichen Kultur geprägt ist. Beeindruckend ist dabei nicht nur der spektakuläre Viehtrieb auf die Lechtaler Almen, bei denen 450 Rinder einen 2.500 Meter hohen Sattel überqueren, sondern auch die wiedergewonnene Wertschätzung der Almen als Urlaubsort.

Durch den Unfalltod des Pichlerbauern sind dessen Frau Ilse, Oma Burgi und vor allem die jüngste Tochter Anna plötzlich alleine auf dem Bergbauernhof. Entgegen aller Erwartungen und Traditionen erbt Anna den Hof. Eine wohlüberlegte Entscheidung des Vaters: Denn Anna will unter allen Umständen Bergbäuerin bleiben, das Erbe ihres Vaters bewahren. Ganz im Gegensatz zu ihrer Mutter und ihrem Onkel.

p.t: Auf uralten Pfaden Viehtriebe im Hochgebirge
p.d: Seit Jahrhunderten schon ziehen Menschen mit ihren Tieren auf Pfaden übers Gebirge. Zwei junge Menschen aus Südtirol treten das Erbe der Vorfahren an: ein Hirte, der mit Schafen vom Schnalstal ins österreichische Ötztal geht, und eine Sennerin.

Die Dokumentation zeigt das unverfälschte Leben im Alpenraum und stellt Menschen vor, die Traditionen bewahren. Ob Handwerk, Almwirtschaft oder dörflicher Alltag, die Kamera fängt die besondere Verbundenheit zur Natur ein.

Benedikt Stirner kehrt nach zehn Jahren auf das inständige Bitten seiner Mutter zurück in die Heimat, um sich mit seinem Vater zu versöhnen. Doch er wird weder vom Vater noch von seinem Bruder mit offenen Armen empfangen. Sein Vater macht ihn für den Tod des jüngsten Sohnes während einer Klettertour verantwortlich. Benedikts Bruder Anton verheimlicht, dass er die Wahrheit hinter dem Unfall kennt, mit der er Benedikt entlasten könnte. Denn Anton liebt mittlerweile Benedikts Ex-Freundin.

Die Flugbegleiterin Sophie liebt die Veränderung. Ihr neuester Plan verlangt nach frischer Luft und einem kompletten Neuanfang im Grünen. Aus diesem Grund kauft sich die Münchenerin einen abgelegenen Bauernhof. Ihrem Mann gefällt der Plan nicht.

Der Chiemsee wird von einer ganz neuen Seite gezeigt: Abseits der bekannten Touristenattraktionen existiert eine Vielzahl von unbekannten Orten. Gertraud Dinzinger erkundet auf ihrem Fahrrad das bayrische Meer ihrer Kindheit.

Sascha Bergmann und Anni Sulmtaler werden zu einem verdächtigen Todesfall nach Murbruck gerufen. Rudolf Stiegler wurde in seinem Haus überfallen und starb anscheinend an einem Herzinfarkt. Der Tote war Direktor der Privatbank am Hauptplatz.
Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

A visit to Butterchurn Guesthouse in Otterburn, Northumberland where hosts Darren and Bobby hope to hit the high notes with their home-from-home B&B. A noisy night and mattress moans leave some of the guests disgruntled.

Daniella and Angela host the second visit at their Hillside Hotel in Dunbar in East Lothian. All their guests coo over the view, but Darren feels he has been sold short by his attic room, and the B&B owners take on a rope obstacle course.

In Blackpool, Paul and entertainer Victoria are keen to put on a show for the B&B owners at their Bella Vista Lodge. Paul and Victoria use bingo and karaoke to try to overcome their guests' preconceptions about the seaside town.

Simon and Lana host the final visit at North Star Sanctum in Fitling in Yorkshire. They aim to lay on luxury with their lodges. It is disheartening when one guest compares the place to a caravan park.
It is payment day, and the B&B owners take each other to task on everything from insufficient slumber to hopeless hosting, before the payments are revealed and the winner is announced.

Four pairs of bed and breakfast owners put their reputations on the line by staying at each other's establishments. They pay only what they deem to be an acceptable amount or the experience, with one establishment being named as the best value.

Mother-and-daughter team Trisha and Lucy host the week's second visit at Piggles Retreat in Brinkley, Cambridgeshire. The cabins at their glampsite are undoubtedly plush, but one set of B&Bers can't handle the extra jaunt to get to the loos.

Four pairs of bed and breakfast owners put their reputations on the line by staying at each other's establishments. They pay only what they deem to be an acceptable amount or the experience, with one establishment being named as the best value.

The B&Bers don their cowboy boots for a proper, authentic, no-detail-spared visit to the Wild West at Hank's Ranch in Norfolk. Hank and Sarah's yeehaw-awesome place offers guests a chance to have some fun and revisit simpler times.

Payment day promises to be a fiery affair after two sets of B&Bers in particular participated in tit-for-tat marking throughout the week. And when the dust settles, the payments are revealed and the winners announced.

In Essex, Kirstie is working with a £1,000,000 pot to find Tom and Lisa a family home. In East London, design-conscious couple James and Anisha have been searching for their first home together for almost two years.

p.t: Kirstie and Phil's Love It or List It: Brilliant Builds
p.d: Kirstie and Phil revisit families who literally hit a brick wall, from a cramped cottage in Radlett to a roof-raising renovation in Chester.
Gary and Janet have sold up in the UK and are ready to take early retirement in Orihuela, a traditional Spanish city. Laura Hamilton tries to find them their forever home in the sun.

Everyone in the Portokalos family worries about Toula (Nia Vardalos). Still unmarried at 30 years old, she works at Dancing Zorba's, the Greek restaurant owned by her parents, Gus (Michael Constantine) and Maria (Lainie Kazan). After taking a job at her aunt's travel agency, she falls in love with Ian Miller (John Corbett), a teacher who is tall, handsome and definitely not Greek. Toula isn't sure which will be more upsetting to her father, that Ian is a foreigner or that he's a vegetarian.

When U.S. government operative Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise) and his mentor, Jim Phelps (Jon Voight), go on a covert assignment that takes a disastrous turn, Jim is killed, and Ethan becomes the prime murder suspect. Now a fugitive, Hunt recruits brilliant hacker Luther Stickell (Ving Rhames) and maverick pilot Franz Krieger (Jean Reno) to help him sneak into a heavily guarded CIA building to retrieve a confidential computer file that will prove his innocence.

"Blood Simple" was the first feature film from Joel and Ethan Coen. This is the newly restored and re-edited director's cut of the film, introduced by Mortimer Young. The stylish crime thriller premiered at film festivals in 1984. "Blood Simple" begins deep in the heart of Texas, where a jealous saloon owner hires a cheap divorce detective to kill the saloon owner's younger wife and her bartender lover. But the detective gets a better idea.
A gay teen tries to adjust to a new life after moving from Cambodia to America with his mother.

The landmark documentary about the tragically ill-fated Rolling Stones free concert at Altamont Speedway on December 6, 1969. Only four months earlier, Woodstock defined the Love Generation; now it lay in ruins on a desolate racetrack six miles outside of San Francisco.
A timid engineer develops a wild and expressive split personality that helps her stand up to male co-workers.

In this Japanese monster movie, the massive Godzilla comes to the aid of his newborn son, who hatches from an egg on a remote island where scientists are conducting experiments with radioactivity. Revealing a surprising paternal streak, Godzilla tries to teach his much smaller progeny how to use his powers. The father/son team must then battle giant insects, including praying mantises and a formidable spider. Can Godzilla protect his curious tyke from the gargantuan bugs?

After Dr. Bill Hartford's (Tom Cruise) wife, Alice (Nicole Kidman), admits to having sexual fantasies about a man she met, Bill becomes obsessed with having a sexual encounter. He discovers an underground sexual group and attends one of their meetings -- and quickly discovers that he is in over his head.

p.t: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory
p.d: The last of five coveted "golden tickets" falls into the hands of a sweet but very poor boy. He and his grandpa then get a tour of the strangest chocolate factory in the world. The owner leads five young winners on a thrilling and often dangerous tour of his factory.

Based on the beloved Roald Dahl tale, this comedic and fantastical film follows young Charlie Bucket (Freddie Highmore) and his Grandpa Joe (David Kelly) as they join a small group of contest winners who get to tour the magical and mysterious factory of eccentric candy maker Willy Wonka (Johnny Depp). Aided by his diminutive Oompa Loompa workers (Deep Roy), Wonka has a hidden motivation for the tour, one that he will reveal only after the children in the group show their true colors.

After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

Julieta descubre que su esposo Alberto, veterinario, atiende más a las dueñas que a los animalitos. Cuando Alberto se entera de que Julieta también lo engaña, empieza a enviarle cartas de amor bajo un pseudónimo.

Cinco mujeres, cinco historias entrecruzadas con el nexo común del calzado. Cada una recorre las calles de Madrid en busca de una nueva oportunidad en el amor: son cinco cenicientas sin príncipe azul que buscan segundas y terceras oportunidades.

En la Galicia de los años 80, la reconversión de la pesca ha dejado en paro a muchos trabajadores. Ante esta situación, los antiguos traficantes de tabaco dan el salto a algo más grande, más lucrativo, pero mucho más peligroso: las drogas.

En España, en 1905, un hombre consigue trabajo como camarero en el Gran Hotel para investigar la extraña desaparición de su hermana. Lo que desconoce es que en su camino está a punto de cruzarse con su gran amor.

El amante de Pepa la traiciona cuando le arrebata al hijo de ambos y se lo da a su esposa, quien acaba de dar a luz a un niño muerto. Pepa se arma de coraje y promete regresar por su hijo y por venganza.

p.d: El Dr. Charles Stanley, pastor de la primera iglesia bautista de Atlanta, comparte sus ideas sobre la fe cristiana e instruye a los espectadores con motivación espiritual.

Vision Television tiene como anfitrión a Gerald Flurry, quien presenta un análisis semanal de los acontecimientos mundiales. A través de la perspectiva de la profecía bíblica, Flurry entrega los mensajes de advertencia, a menudo sobre cuestiones relacionadas con el creciente poder e influencia de la Unión Europea. A partir de los estudios de la Iglesia de Dios de Filadelfia," La llave de David" intenta sobresalir entre la programación devocional de hoy en día. Sus espectadores se han referido al programa como franco, valiente y racional, sin sentimentalismo emocional exagerado.
Un vistazo a los acontecimientos actuales con un enfoque a la política actual y entrevistas a los principales protagonistas de las noticias, así como de una mesa redonda con destacados profesionales.

A Romanian police officer, determined to free from prison a crooked businessman who knows where a mobster's money is hidden, must learn the difficult ancestral language used on the island of Gomera.

Elisa is a mute, isolated woman who works in a hidden, high-security government laboratory. Her life changes forever when she discovers the lab's classified secret -- a mysterious, scaled creature from South America that lives in a water tank.

After deciding to sell their zoo in India and move to Canada, Santosh and Gita Patel board a freighter with their sons and a few remaining animals. Tragedy strikes when a terrible storm sinks the ship, leaving the Patels' teenage son, Pi, as the only human survivor. However, Pi is not alone; a fearsome Bengal tiger has also found refuge aboard the lifeboat. As days turn into weeks and weeks drag into months, Pi and the tiger must learn to trust each other if both are to survive.

Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans.
Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan.
Japan comes under attack from two monsters in a giant monster battle between a rampaging Godzilla and the colossal genetically engineered moth called Mothra.
Godzilla and Anguirus fight three-headed dragon Ghidorah and huge bird Gigan at a cartoonist's theme park.
Scientists face Godzilla, Rodan, Mothra and more obscure Japanese monsters sent by she-aliens.
A monster dinosaur wrecks Tokyo some more and meets a monster plant created from his own cells.

Krypto the Super-Dog and Superman are inseparable best friends, sharing the same superpowers and fighting crime side by side in Metropolis. However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission.

Beth ve a Rick haciendo abdominales durante la noche, y la familia descubre que tiene un dispositivo que controla su cuerpo mientras duerme. Ahora todos quieren probarlo.
Pim y Charlie reciben la gran tarea de salvar a la Madre Naturaleza.

Keiji, el gallo errante, se hace amigo de un anciano en una nueva ciudad. Al hablar con él, recuerda a su hermana devorada por un demonio. De pronto, un demonio amenaza la ciudad y Keiji debe enfrentarlo para proteger a su amigo.
Chris es retenido en una plataforma petrolera por unos espías rusos. El equipo se propone salvarla a pesar de descubrir su pasado.
Joseph sueña con tener el control de la infraestructura energética del país y ha utilizado a la organización ninja de Yamaji como su ejército privado para lograr su cometido.

Durante un tenso juego de cartas, algunos Titanes son enviados a otra dimensión, donde se libra una batalla para decidir quién es el mejor guerrero de todos los tiempos.
Artemis reconoce a Jade Cheshire como la que robó un maletín en Nueva Orleans. El maletín, que contiene biotecnología integrada, es crucial para los planes de la Liga de la Injusticia.
Todos los miembros de la Liga están bajo el dominio mental de Vandal Savage por medio de un organismo extraterrestre fabricado por nanotecnología y magia.

After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives.

Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

John Rambo (Sylvester Stallone) is doing hard time in jail when his former boss, Col. Trautman (Richard Crenna), offers him a deal. If Rambo travels to Vietnam to try to find the American prisoners of war, his criminal record will be expunged. Rambo takes the reconnaissance assignment and agrees not to get involved in any of the action. However, when his Vietnamese lover, Co Bao (Julia Nickson), is killed by American forces, Rambo forgets his promise and takes matters into his own hands.

After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt.

ZZ Top is an American rock band formed in 1969 in Groves, Texas; since 1970, the band consists of bassist and vocalist Dusty Hill, guitarist and lead vocalist Billy Gibbons, and drummer Frank Beard.

Created by a small group of iconoclastic artists in the 1970s and early 1980s, Outlaw Country represents freedom from the Nashville establishment that dictated the sound of most country music of the era. Outlaw Country has its roots in earlier subgenres like Western, honky-tonk, rockabilly and progressive country, and is characterized by a blend of rock and folk rhythms, country instrumentation, and introspective lyrics.

Both a descriptor used for the bars that provide country music for the entertainment of their patrons and a style of music played in such establishments, honky-tonk is a multifaceted musical experience.
Singer-songwriter James Taylor creates music that combines folk, rock and pop sensibilities, including such hit songs as "Fire and Rain" and "Shower the People."

Fronted by Eric Clapton, power trio Cream plays a mix of blues, rock and psychedelia while focusing on chunky riffs and fiery guitar solos; in a mere three years, the band sells 15 million records and redefines the instrumentalist's role in rock.

Chaos reigns in the New York City subway system when heavily armed criminals, led by a mastermind named Ryder (John Travolta), hijack a subway train and threaten to kill everyone on board unless a large ransom is paid. Dispatcher Walter Garber (Denzel Washington) uses his extensive knowledge of the transit system in a bid to outwit the hijackers and save the hostages, but one question remains: even if the hijackers get their money, how can they possibly escape?

A top Marine sniper, Bob Lee Swagger, leaves the military after a mission goes awry and disappears without a trace. Swagger is coaxed back into service after high-profile government officials convince him to help thwart a plot against the President of the United States. Swagger realizes he has been betrayed and becomes the target of a nationwide manhunt. Instead of hiding, he seeks revenge against some of the most powerful and corrupt leaders in the free world.

Hondo Harrelson (Samuel L. Jackson) recruits Jim Street (Colin Farrell) to join an elite unit of the Los Angeles Police Department. Together they seek out more members, including tough Deke Kay (LL Cool J) and single mom Chris Sanchez (Michelle Rodriguez). The team's first big assignment is to escort crime boss Alex Montel (Olivier Martinez) to prison. It seems routine, but when Montel offers a huge reward to anyone who can break him free, criminals of various stripes step up for the prize.

Adventure junkies Simon Donato and Paul "Turbo" Trebilcock try to prove that boundaries are meant to be broken as they test their limits in some of the world's toughest endurance races. Donato, who holds a doctorate in geology, is the brains of the duo and a self-proclaimed nomad. Trebilcock, a dedicated athlete with a background in running, is considered the heart of the team. Together, they participate in competitions that include a seven-day race through volcanic terrain in Iceland, a 46-mile foot race with obstacles, and a 142-mile run through Cambodian jungles. From running, biking, skiing, swimming and climbing, their love for the rush coupled with their undeniable stamina makes it a wild ride with a few cuts and bruised egos along the way. Endurance athletes Rory Bosio and Hunter McIntyre join the team beginning in Season 3.

Salvador Mallo, cinéaste en déclin, se remémore son enfance dans les années 60, lorsqu'il a émigré avec ses parents dans un village de Valence en quête de prospérité, son premier amour à Madrid dans les années 80, la douleur d'une rupture, l'écriture comme thérapie pour oublier l'inoubliable, la découverte précoce du cinéma et le vide, le vide infini qui crée l'incapacité de continuer à faire des films.
Fin de la programmation.

À la suite d'un malentendu, Gus est persuadé que Gaga, le ClicTi, est rejeté par le Chevalier des Ombres et qu'il serait beaucoup mieux au château ; le nouveau pensionnaire n'arrive toutefois pas à s'adapter et accumule les gaffes.

Toupie et Binou sont de retour ! Une idée suffit pour que le quotidien des deux meilleurs amis devienne un périple extraordinaire ; portés par une imagination sans limites, ils plongent dans des aventures comiques, surprenantes et touchantes.
Jérémy et le reste de la bande apprennent à dire bonjour dans différentes langues du monde entier.
Ella et Slippy s'exercent à l'escalade dans le but de grimper un nouveau cratère sur Encelade; mais Ella préfère utiliser ses astrobottes plutôt que de s'entraîner.
Les aventures amusantes et surprenantes des animonstres.
Le parc national du Mont-Saint-Bruno est reconnu pour abriter de nombreux oiseaux de proie ; Arthur et ses amis aventuriers y font une chasse au trésor afin de découvrir leurs caractéristiques.

Arthur et les aventuriers visitent le parc national du Mont-Orford pour y découvrir quelques rongeurs ; ils ont comme défi d'associer le castor, le porc-épic et le tamia rayé aux éléments de la nature qu'ils rongent.

Des insectes qui vivent aussi longtemps que les humains; Émilie fouille la question puis se rend à l'Insectarium de Montréal afin de découvrir quels insectes vivent le moins longtemps et comment on reconnaît un vieux papillon.

On découvre de quoi ont l'air les oeufs d'une coccinelle; à l'Insectarium de Montréal, Émilie découvre une grande variété d'oeufs d'insectes; Émilie montre ensuite comment retirer la coquille dure d'un oeuf de poule frais sans le casser.
Quand on fait des cabrioles, le plus important est de savoir retomber sur ses pattes ; top 10 des réceptions et arrêts d'anthologie avec Mike.
On a décidé de fabriquer notre propre éolienne pour faire de l'électricité; on transforme un meuble avec de la peinture aérosol et l'on emballe des cadeaux avec la méthode japonaise du furoshiki.

Amély apprend la base de l'escalade avec Loïc Briand, qui a grimpé des falaises partout en Amérique du Nord ; Lori'anne se rend dans la maison longue de Wendake pour jouer du tambour d'eau ; Antoine et Maya tweetent avec le pont Jacques-Cartier.

Amély réussit son premier entraînement d'aviron ; Antoine et Loïc reproduisent un tour de magie créé par Alain Choquette et Lori'anne apprend à conduire le rover lunaire à l'Agence spatiale canadienne.

Michel se disfrazó de Kory y se presentó a un examen con la intención de ayudarla, pero fue descubierto y ambos fueron sancionados y expulsados del sistema educativo.
Su esposo quiere despedir a la doula por insistir en un embarazo al margen de médicos. Los celos y favoritismo de su novia y supervisora fueron la causa de que la tuviera que despedir.
Le dan somníferos para que se mantenga delgada y pueda modelar. Practicaba sexo extremo con la hermana de su esposa, ella muere y le deja una herencia que no puede cobrar por estar involucrado.
Rafael es un hombre muy bueno y dueño de una carpintería. Pero a su alrededor solo tiene a gente falsa que lo quiere ver caer. Con mucha fe, él podrá solucionar los problemas y las deudas.
Martín es un campeón de natación y está enamorado de Valeria. El padre de él está obsesionado con que se convierta en un medallista y no acepta la relación.

El Zurdo detecta que en su fiesta hay una señal y que proviene de Teresa, la lleva a su despacho para despejar dudas y ella no duda: ha quedado al descubierto y tiene que decir la verdad. Epifanio, por su parte, habla públicamente sobre sus romances.

Francesco le ofrece un futuro romántico a Teresa: sueña con pasear con ella por Roma, acompañados de Sofía, quien se da cuenta de que Lupo y su mamá están hablando y estalla, llena de rabia. Epifanio quiere casarse con Veva, le pese a quien le pese.
Las Pernas llegan a México con sed de venganza, no pueden perder tiempo y buscan de inmediato a Teresa. Ella contraataca y ejecuta un plan contra el Zurdo Villa y sus enemigos gallegos.
Vicky muere después de la cesárea y Lucía, con el corazón roto, le comunica a su familia. Octavio, Daniel y Lucha sienten que no fue un accidente, aunque son otros quienes pueden asegurarlo.
Daniel detiene a Rafael por un testimonio del que no tiene evidencias, Radamés y Montes conspiran y el infiltrado actúa. Lucía tiene un sueño revelador cuando se muda obligada por su esposo.
Daniel es destituido de su cargo y detenido por el asesinato de Anselmo, confirma que hay un infiltrado y no deja de pensar en Lucía. Rodríguez escucha una conversación entre Montes y Radamés.

Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence.

When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

Lee, a solitary American in Mexico City, falls for a beautiful, elusive former soldier. Journeying together into the jungle, Lee sees, for the first time, the possibility of an intimate and infinite love.

When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

p.t: Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
p.d: Godzilla and the almighty Kong face a colossal threat hidden deep within the planet, challenging their very existence and the survival of the human race.

Thirty years after starring in "The Wizard of Oz," beloved actress and singer Judy Garland arrives in London to perform sold-out shows at the Talk of the Town nightclub. While there, she reminisces with friends and fans and begins a whirlwind romance with musician Mickey Deans, her soon-to-be fifth husband.

Acosados por los sucesos aterradores que ocurren en su casa, Kelly y Ben descubren que un experimento de parapsicología universitario produjo una entidad que ahora los está persiguiendo. El malévolo espíritu se alimenta del miedo y los tormentos de la pareja sin importar a dónde huyan. Desesperados, Kelly y Ben buscan a un investigador de lo paranormal, pero aun con su ayuda, podría ser muy tarde para salvarse de la presencia terrorífica.
Padres divorciados deben trabajar juntos para salvar a su joven hija de una entidad malévola que habita en una caja antigua.
Una pareja adicta al trabajo decide tomarse unas vacaciones buceando en las Bahamas. Sin embargo, la lancha que los lleva al medio de la mar los abandona en unas aguas infestadas de tiburones.
Un criminal en la Inglaterra del futuro pasa una serie de procesos experimentales para corregir sus impulsos violentos.

En Ciudad de México, en la década de 1950, Lee, un estadounidense solitario, se enamora de Allerton, un soldado. La pareja emprende un viaje juntos, pero, mientras Lee busca un amor profundo, Allerton no concibe su relación de la misma manera.
Con la ayuda de su mejor amigo, un soldado estadounidense que regresó de Afganistán emprende la búsqueda de su esposa y su hijo en un país devastado.

Jonás Taylor lidera un equipo de investigación en las profundidades del océano. Acorralados por colosales tiburones prehistóricos y despiadados bandidos, los científicos intentan sobrevivir a toda costa.

Un ambicioso joven que acaba de salir del Ejército acepta un trabajo como barman en un local nocturno de Nueva York para poder costear sus estudios. Enseguida se convierte en la atracción del lugar y encara un nuevo plan: abrir su propio bar.

p.d: Godzilla y Kong se enfrentan a una amenaza colosal escondida en lo profundo del planeta, desafiando su propia existencia y la supervivencia de la raza humana.

Treinta años después de haber protagonizado "El mago de Oz", la actriz y cantante Judy Garland llega a Londres para ofrecer una actuación en un club. Mientras está allí, la estrella de Hollywood recuerda su vida y conoce al que será su quinto esposo.
Owen y Claire regresan a la isla para salvar a los dinosaurios de un volcán a punto de erupción. Juntos descubren un extraño avance evolutivo y una conspiración que amenaza a todo el planeta.
En la década de los ochenta, la CIA contrata al piloto americano Barry Seal para una misión encubierta que dio origen al Cartel de Medellín y casi termina con la presidencia de Ronald Reagan.

En el día que mueren sus padres, las hermanas Lilly y Victoria desaparecen en el bosque. Su tío Lucas y su novia, Anabel, comienzan a buscarlas incansablemente. No es hasta pasados cinco años cuando las encuentran vivas en una cabaña, y Lucas y Anabel las reciben en su casa. Pero, mientras intentan que se adapten a su nueva vida, descubren que hay algo que todavía las quiere conservar en la oscuridad.
Dos niños, uno en España y el otro en Inglaterra son atemorizados por un fantasma encapuchado sin rostro que salió de un cuento de terror que ellos escribieron.

El mundo del ciclismo profesional visto desde dentro, a través de los ojos de cinco deportistas. El director, Andy Samberg, propone un enfoque paródico y mordaz para abordar la tragedia del doping en el ciclismo de alta competición.

p.t: El nuevo traje nuevo del emperador
p.d: Un emperador al que nadie se atreve a contradecir recibe una lección de humildad cuando un niño expresa lo que todos piensan y, por temor, nadie manifiesta.
Mientras lucha con las repercusiones de su origen y sus habilidades extraordinarias, el joven Clark Kent debe convertirse en un héroe y salvar a las personas que ama de una grave amenaza.

Diana, hija de dioses y princesa de las amazonas, nunca ha salido de su isla, hasta que un piloto accidentado que llega a la isla le explica que se está desarrollando una gran guerra que puede destruir el mundo, y Diana parte a la batalla.

Sean Boswell es un piloto de carreras callejeras, pero sufre un choque al final de una carrera. Decide mudarse a Japón para evitar cumplir una condena en Estados Unidos, ya que las carreras son ilegales. En Tokio, comienza a aprender un nuevo y emocionante estilo de competir en las calles. Sin embargo, los riesgos aumentan aún más cuando Sean decide desafiar al campeón local y termina enamorándose de su novia.
Una máquina del tiempo transporta a un adolescente a los años 50, cuando sus padres todavía estudiaban en la secundaria.

Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

Plagued by frightening occurrences in their home, Kelly (Ashley Greene) and Ben (Sebastian Stan) learn that a university's parapsychology experiment produced an entity that is now haunting them. The malevolent spirit feeds on fear and torments the couple no matter where they run. Desperate, Kelly and Ben turn to a paranormal researcher (Tom Felton), but even with his aid, it may already be too late to save themselves from the terrifying presence.

When their youngest daughter, Em (Natasha Calis), becomes strangely obsessed with an antique wooden box bought from a yard sale, parents Clyde (Jeffrey Dean Morgan) and Stephanie (Kyra Sedgwick) see little cause for alarm. However, Em becomes increasingly unstable, leading the couple to fear the presence of a malevolent force. To their horror, Clyde and Stephanie learn that the box contains a dybbuk, a dislocated spirit that inhabits -- and ultimately devours -- a human host.

Daniel (Daniel Travis) and Susan (Blanchard Ryan) embark on a tropical vacation with their scuba-diving certifications in tow. During a group dive, the two separate themselves from the others to dive a little deeper. An incorrect head-count suggests the entire group has returned, so the boat departs. When the pair surfaces, they make out a vessel in the distance, but it does not immediately set in that they have been left behind. With sharks lurking beneath, their survival chances grow smaller.

In an England of the future, Alex and his "Droogs" spend their nights getting high at the Korova Milkbar before embarking on "a little of the old ultraviolence," while jauntily warbling "Singin' in the Rain." After he's jailed for bludgeoning the Cat Lady to death, Alex submits to behavior modification technique to earn his freedom; he's conditioned to abhor violence. Returned to the world defenseless, Alex becomes the victim of his prior victims.

Lee, a solitary American in Mexico City, falls for a beautiful, elusive former soldier. Journeying together into the jungle, Lee sees, for the first time, the possibility of an intimate and infinite love.

When U.S. Marine Gabriel Drummer (Shia LaBeouf) returns from Afghanistan, he finds the place he once called home is no better than the battlefields he fought on overseas. Accompanied by his best friend, a hard-nosed Marine whose natural instinct is to shoot first and ask questions later, Gabriel searches desperately for his estranged son and his wife, leading to a suspect who has vital information about their location.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

Brian Flanagan (Tom Cruise) wants a high-paying marketing job, but needs a business degree first. Working as a bartender to pay for college, Flanagan is mentored by his veteran boss, Doug Coughlin (Bryan Brown). Together, their showy tricks and charisma command large crowds and tip payments -- until Flanagan and the cynical Coughlin have a falling out. Flanagan moves to Jamaica to raise enough money to open his own bar, where he falls in love with artist Jordan Mooney (Elisabeth Shue).

p.d: La fascinante y polifacética Europa para un público internacional. El Viejo Continente y su gente: países y estilos de vida, sus costumbres, su ambiente, su sociedad y su glamour.

Análisis de la actualidad.

Una revista de viaje que muestra Alemania cada semana en toda su diversidad y belleza. Volar con la mente a parajes insospechados y también, para dar la palabra a quienes descubren Alemania recorriendo sus ciudades y paisajes naturales.

Un hombre insatisfecho y una mujer misteriosa creen que están viviendo en una realidad simulada, pero luego deben decidir qué es real y dónde pertenecen realmente.
Un policía con conexiones en el submundo criminal registra un club nocturno en búsqueda de su hijo secuestrado.

Tom, un policía en la década de 1950 en Gran Bretaña, se enamora de un maestro de escuela en la costa de Brighton. Sin embargo, pronto comienza una apasionada aventura entre personas del mismo sexo con el curador de un museo.

p.t: SIn City 2: Una dama por la cual mataría
p.d: Varias historias se cruzan en las calles de Sin City: Dwight trata de vengarse de la misteriosa Ava Lord, la mujer fatal que lo traicionó; Nancy intenta sobreponerse a la muerte de Hartigan; y Johnny debe matar al villano más peligroso de la ciudad.

Raoul y Emile accidentalmente liberan a un monstruo del excéntrico invernadero de un científico e intentan atraparlo. Pronto descubren que la bestia podría no ser tan amenazante como aparenta e intentan salvarla de un corrupto jefe de policía.
Un estudiante universitario y su profesor de matemáticas investigan una serie de avistamientos de ovnis.
Una profesora grosera, malhablada e irresponsable compite con una modélica colega por la atención de un profesor sustituto guapo y rico.

Seis astronautas descubren indicios de la existencia de vida inteligente en Marte. Cuando comienzan a investigar, se dan cuenta de que esa forma de vida está mucho más evolucionada y es infinitamente más aterradora de lo que habían supuesto.

La historia de Forrest Tucker, quien logró fugarse 18 veces de prisión, la última con 70 años, y cometió robos espectaculares. El encargado de perseguirlo fue John Hunt, un agente que quedó cautivado por la maestría de Tucker al dar sus golpes.

Crónica de las revueltas, motivadas por el racismo imperante, que sacudieron Detroit durante el verano de 1967. Todo comenzó cuando la policía disparó a tres hombres desarmados durante una redada nocturna. La respuesta ciudadana derivó en uno de los episodios de disturbios civiles más violentos de la historia de los Estados Unidos.
Christina Anstead es una experta en la compra, reforma y venta de casas, que transforma las propiedades antiguas de sus clientes en viviendas con un alto valor en el sur de California.

p.t: Tu casa, un hogar con Mabel Cartagena
p.d: Mabel Cartagena enseña a cómo hacer que la vivienda sea el mejor hogar del mundo.

Karen y Nina, madre e hija, forman un equipo perfecto. Las dos juntas se encargan de renovar casas antiguas en su ciudad, Indianápolis. Compran cada casa que ven deteriorada y la reforman, dejándola irreconocible.

Familias en Vancouver, la ciudad más grande de la Columbia Británica luchan con casas que no se ajustan a sus necesidades y deben decidir entre mudarse a otro mejor sitio o continuar viviendo en su casa recientemente renovada.
Personas cuentan historias impactantes sobre cómo comparten sus hogares con sus seres queridos, que se convierten en asesinos.
La cirujana dermatológica Sandra Lee se encarga de eliminar los tumores que afectan la vida de sus pacientes para que puedan recuperar la normalidad en sus vidas.

Para aprovechar el mercado, Tarek y Christina planean una reforma rápida para una casa pequeña. Si bien sus movimientos rápidos podrían generar una buena ganancia, corren el riesgo de apresurar los detalles importantes.

Andrea pasa la mayor parte del tiempo acostada en la cama, sola, comiendo. Sin aliento ni energía para llevar una vida activa, ahora tiene graves problemas de salud. La cirugía bariátrica es su única esperanza.

La vida de Margaret, que pesa 350 kilos, necesita un cambio. A los 35 años, es una niña de mamá. Es hora de que Margaret se levante de la cama, supere su adicción a la comida y se aleje de la comodidad de su madre para poder finalmente vivir su vida.

Margaret logró someterse con éxito a una cirugía, pero el Dr. Now se preocupa cuando ella y su madre vuelven a las andadas unos meses después. Megan se impacienta con su lenta pérdida de peso y, si el Dr. Now no aprueba su cirugía, podría renunciar.

Irene tuvo que volver a vivir con su hijo porque su peso le hacía insoportable vivir sola. Luego de ignorar al Dr. Now, lo único que podría ayudarla a romper el ciclo es un acontecimiento único en la vida.

En tiempos difíciles, la comida siempre ha sido la amiga de Tammy. Ahora, ha subido tanto de peso que sus hijas y su madre se mudaron con ella para cuidarla, y a menos que el Dr. Now logre que se enfrente a su dolor, la comida podría ser su asesina.
Eighteen celebrities compete to win the coveted MasterChef title and, to do so, they must show off their culinary skills.

Buddy Valastro's family-owned business, Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken, N.J., is booming, and it's bound to get even busier after viewers get an inside look at how Buddy and his staff, including his mom, four sisters and three brothers-in-law, produce thousands of wedding cakes, specialty cakes (as in Britney Spears' circus-theme 27th birthday cake) and pastries every week.

Her actual name is Sandra Lee, but she is so popular in her field of dermatology that she is known by most people as Dr. Pimple Popper. In 2015, Dr. Lee began to provide a window into her job by filming dermatological procedures -- some quite gruesome, like blackhead extractions and cyst dissections -- and posting them to her website and across other social media outlets. Lo and behold, Lee gained a prominent online fan base, including a YouTube channel with more than 3 million followers called "Popaholics." Now comes a reality show on TLC, which says Lee is a "celebrity who has pioneered the fastest growing medical fascination in decades."

"Body Bizarre" introduces viewers to people with rare, mysterious medical conditions so uncommon that even top doctors and other experts don't know much about the anomalies; each episode uncovers several cases from around the world, features personal interviews with afflicted individuals and explains the science behind each condition; among those profiled are a girl born with black spots and fur on her face and body, the first American to undergo a face transplant and a man with a facial tumor so severe that he may not survive the surgery needed to remove it.

While many may find feet to be an unusual topic for a television series, "Dr. Pimple Popper" has proven that there is a demographic for just about anything. "My Feet Are Killing Me" follows Drs. Brad Schaeffer, Ebonie Vincent and Sarah Haller, podiatrists who radically transfer the feet and lives of their patients. While viewers may be shocked by the subject matter, each episode open with a warning that some scenes may be graphic. Drs. Brad and Sarah are based in New Jersey, where they help the feet of the East, whereas Dr. Ebonie practices her passion for the paws in Southern California.

"Good Bones" follows the blueprint of several series on HGTV or DIY Network that showcase revitalization specialists who turn rundown homes into stunning remodels. In this case, it's mother/daughter duo Karen E. Laine and Mina Starsiak transforming properties in and around their hometown of Indianapolis. Karen's legal background and Mina's real estate knowledge help them secure diamonds in the rough, and then they hire out demo and construction duties -- or get help from family -- to get the houses done on time and on budget.

p.t: Love It or List It Vancouver
p.d: "Love It or List It" moves west to Vancouver. Families in the largest city in British Columbia are struggling with homes that don't fit their needs. In each episode, interior designer Jillian Harris and real estate agent Todd Talbot help homeowners decide whether to love it or list it. Harris attempts to revive the love the owners once had for their homes with a complete renovation, while Talbot tries to persuade them to relocate using the temptation of a dreamy new place. They weigh their options to keep their current -- but remodeled -- home, or to leave it for something better.

A shared love of simple, Southern living and revitalizing historic properties keeps Ben and Erin Napier busy in their hometown of Laurel, Miss. That's the setting of this HGTV series, which follows the couple as they renovate turn-of-the-century homes for first-time buyers, young families, and adults wishing to live closer to grandchildren. Erin's keen sense of style and a background in graphic design guide the renovations, Ben's building and woodworking skills preserve and celebrate the home's history, and by using found materials and old textiles, they keep the character intact but create modern and affordable updates.

The "Property Brothers," Drew and Jonathan Scott, take their tag-team real estate partnership to the next level in "Buying and Selling." Drew helps home buyers find the right property to purchase, but before closing on the deal, the buyers' current home needs attention, and lots of it, in order to make it salable. That's where Jonathan comes in. To leverage its value, Jonathan comes up with a plan to breathe fresh life into the home, and he and his contracting team take over from there. Drew then oversees the selling of the renovated home and the buying of a new house.

Buying a house is no easy task, but when it's in another country, imagine the stresses of negotiating in a foreign language; emotions run high as realtors and their clients leave their milieu to look for new properties abroad in this spinoff of HGTV's popular "House Hunters."

In order to take advantage of a hot market, Tarek and Christina plan a quick flip for a small house on a big lot; while their fast moves could land a big payday, they risk rushing the important details and creating bigger problems down the road.
Andrea spends most of her time lying in bed, alone, eating meals; without the breath or energy for an active life, she faces serious health problems.

Margaret's life at 700 pounds is in need of a jump-start; at age 35, she is a mama's girl; it's time for Margaret to get out of bed, overcome her food addiction and break away from the comfort of her mother so she can finally live her life.

p.t: My 600-Lb. Life: Where Are They Now?
p.d: Margaret succeeds in getting surgery, but Dr. Now is dismayed when a few months later she and her mom revert to their old ways; Megan grows impatient with her slow weight loss, and if Dr. Now doesn't approve her for surgery soon, she might quit.

Irene had to move back in with her son because her weight made it unbearable to live on her own. When Dr. Now can't get through to her, the only thing that might help her break the cycle is a once-in-a-lifetime turn of events.

Josh Gates se dirige a Montana, el territorio de la Fiebre del Oro, para buscar la desaparecida fortuna del conocido sheriff del Viejo Oeste, Henry Plummer.

Josh Gates viaja a Hungría para unirse a tres equipos de arqueólogos buscando la tumba perdida de Atila, el Rey de los Hunos; leyendas y textos ancestrales llevan la búsqueda al fondo del Danubio hasta bosques montañosos en las afueras de Budapest.
Josh viaja a Grecia para estudiar el pasado de la isla de Creta, la que fuera la primera gran potencia europea.

p.t: Construcciones remotas: oasis en la isla
p.d: Beth quiere un refugio en las arenas blancas de Cayo Ambergris, Belice; Ken Grissom y su equipo transportan toneladas de material a una isla remota para construir un refugio de lujo a solo unos metros de las cálidas aguas del Caribe.

Sage Stoneman está en la búsqueda de nuevas formas de construir viviendas remotas con materiales de construcción naturales que se combinen perfectamente con su entorno. Se une al constructor natural SunRay Kelley para experimentar con un material nunca antes utilizado: los hongos.
Una familia creativa construye una pequeña casa de tres pisos en Maine; con una experiencia limitada y una fecha límite de tres meses, necesitarán la ayuda de gente local de Maine.

Un agente inmobiliario y sus tres hijos quieren construir su casa soñada en una cumbre arbolada en la meseta de Ozark, Oklahoma; mientras superan las adversidades, convierten tres contenedores en un paraíso desconectado del mundo.
Un instructor de motos de nieve y su esposa construyen una cabaña en Wyoming sin usar combustibles fósiles.

Las esperanzas de tener una turbina eólica se ven amenazadas cuando Bear y Gabe tienen un error de cálculo; Noah y Rhain llevan la relación a otro nivel; Matt comienza un proyecto para almacenar alimentos.

From Mexico's Yucatán to Botswana's Okavango Delta, fan favorites Ernie and Mandy return, this time for 21 days; armed with new tools and improved skills, can they survive? Or will Africa eat them alive?
In a first-ever episode, five social media influencers will attempt to use their primitive skills to survive for 14 days on a rugged, remote island in Thailand.
In the American Southwest, a city in the cliffs stands deserted even though it was once home to tens of thousands of people; evidence of human remains reveals how these people came to a violent end.

On the mid-season finale, after losing $11,000 in stolen liquor, Mark and Digger surveil their bootlegger on a delivery to Memphis; Tickle preps to open his own restaurant, but outlaw habits die hard as he makes it a distribution hub for shine.

Guam's brutal wartime past is said to have left more than scars upon its shores; after reports of hostile spirits and unexplained encounters, Phil and Heather venture from haunted battlefields into the island's remote jungle in search of answers.

Paul Sr. and the OCC crew head over to the University of South Florida to get schooled on the effects of Alzheimer's, and possibly get his head checked. They also spend an evening over at the OCC Roadhouse competing for top dog at Bandingo's trivia night.

Our final stop in the Keys takes us to Key West -- it's the end of the road, but the start of countless adventures! We explore a little-known wreck with an untold secret, and travel to waters near Fort Jefferson to document an exclusive story on camera.
Patrice and Kevin McCabe shoot sporting clays, visit highland cows, and fish Tampa Bay while staying at the brand-new LazyDays RV Resort.

With breakthrough discoveries in Egypt, Josh races to join an active dig of 4,000-year-old tombs; Josh gains exclusive access and uncovers mummies and treasure that could solve the mysterious collapse of Ancient Egypt's Old Kingdom.

Investigating the mysterious collapse of Egypt's old kingdom, Josh completes his Saqqara necropolis dig; opening several tombs, Josh finds treasure, clues and haunting remains; testing results may prove they've discovered Egypt's oldest royal mummy.

Josh investigates America's daring response to Pearl Harbor, which destroyed a vital Japanese base in the South Pacific; using brand-new intel, Josh dives in with Project Recover to find 40 planes and 200 American heroes lost in Operation Hailstone.

Josh dives deep into the Navy's Pearl Harbor counterattack, uncovering an eyewitness who shares details of American soldiers' executions; new intel leads to the discovery of the first U.S. plane ever found from this battle.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: When a rare bomb cyclone rocks Buffalo in December 2022, hundreds of eyewitnesses film unprecedented blizzard conditions; but as unrelenting snowfall traps thousands, one woman must brave arctic conditions to save a man freezing to death.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: Hundreds of cameras capture a rare tornado outbreak in 2023 as it strikes Rolling Fork, Miss., and Little Rock, Ark.; when a twister hits Lewistown, Ill., a group of tornado spotters find themselves trapped in the eye of the storm.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: A rare, powerful weather system races 1,000 miles across the Great Lakes, unleashing damaging tornadoes in Canada's capital city, Ottawa. With no warning, residents scramble for safety as the monster storm tears apart apartment blocks and power stations.

Paul Sr. and the OCC crew head over to the University of South Florida to get schooled on the effects of Alzheimer's, and possibly get his head checked. They also spend an evening over at the OCC Roadhouse competing for top dog at Bandingo's trivia night.

Our final stop in the Keys takes us to Key West -- it's the end of the road, but the start of countless adventures! We explore a little-known wreck with an untold secret, and travel to waters near Fort Jefferson to document an exclusive story on camera.
Patrice and Kevin McCabe shoot sporting clays, visit highland cows, and fish Tampa Bay while staying at the brand-new LazyDays RV Resort.

With breakthrough discoveries in Egypt, Josh races to join an active dig of 4,000-year-old tombs; Josh gains exclusive access and uncovers mummies and treasure that could solve the mysterious collapse of Ancient Egypt's Old Kingdom.

Investigating the mysterious collapse of Egypt's old kingdom, Josh completes his Saqqara necropolis dig; opening several tombs, Josh finds treasure, clues and haunting remains; testing results may prove they've discovered Egypt's oldest royal mummy.

Josh investigates America's daring response to Pearl Harbor, which destroyed a vital Japanese base in the South Pacific; using brand-new intel, Josh dives in with Project Recover to find 40 planes and 200 American heroes lost in Operation Hailstone.

Josh dives deep into the Navy's Pearl Harbor counterattack, uncovering an eyewitness who shares details of American soldiers' executions; new intel leads to the discovery of the first U.S. plane ever found from this battle.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm
p.d: Hundreds of cameras capture a rare tornado outbreak in 2023 as it strikes Rolling Fork, Miss., and Little Rock, Ark.; when a twister hits Lewistown, Ill., a group of tornado spotters find themselves trapped in the eye of the storm.

p.t: In the Eye of the Storm

p.t: O.J. Simpson: la explotación del mal

El brutal asesinato de Jessica Chambers, de 19 años, encontrada con graves quemaduras a un lado de la carretera en la zona rural de Courtland, Misisipi, provoca conmoción en todo el país. La búsqueda de su asesino crea una brecha en su comunidad.

Mientras se desarrolla el juicio por el violento asesinato de Jessica Chambers, de 19 años, un impactante giro de los acontecimientos amenaza con desgarrar a su familia y a la comunidad. Todo cambia cuando se descubre otro brutal crimen en Luisiana.
La madre soltera Erin instala un sistema de seguridad después de darse cuenta de que alguien ha estado dentro de su casa.
En 1988, una pareja de Burbank es asesinada en su propia casa, la investigación revela un asesino intrigante que casi se escapó con el asesinato perfecto.

Las sobredosis de famosos acaparan los titulares, los médicos que cometen irregularidades y el imperio multimillonario de las drogas están en la mira por las muertes de famosos, desde Marilyn Monroe hasta Matthew Perry.

Estafas, mentiras y videos sexuales han empañado la reputación de las comedias de situación de instituto de los 90. Amigos, padres y actores revelan las duras realidades a las que se enfrentaron algunos miembros del reparto.

Peppa y familia están de vacaciones cuando descubren que su camioneta se transforma en un barco. El Abuelo Pig los acompaña. Richard Rabbit llega a jugar.

Cuando los niños se entrometen en el sueño de su profesora para encontrar las respuestas de los exámenes, se dan cuenta de que, en sueños, la dulce señorita Putnam no es tan dulce ni tan pequeña.
El perro Terry, creyendo que es un gato, quiere convertirse en el gato bombero e intenta por todos los medios comportarse como un héroe en diversas situaciones para demostrar que es valiente.

La abuela Pina está ansiosa y llena de cosas por hacer porque una invitada muy especial viene a visitarla: su querida nieta. Durante la visita, los gatos descubren que la joven tiene un don extraordinario.

Mo quiere eludir darse la ducha que Selina le está imponiendo antes de poder ir a la sala de videojuegos para una transmisión en vivo con los mejores jugadores de la ciudad, para evitar arruinar su peinado grasiento supergenial y raro.

Sam decide hacer su pasantía de descubrimiento del lugar de trabajo de tres días con su padre, Percy, con la esperanza de enviar el primer ARFD al espacio: Hammy. Mo, por otro lado, ni siquiera ha buscado una pasantía.

Chris tries to unravel a legal mystery involving a woman's sister who she last saw across a New York courtroom 30 years ago.

A Vietnam vet hopes Lisa can help him make amends for the past by locating the daughter he lost custody of forty years ago; a woman's struggle to fit in takes a surprising turn when Chris reveals a series of stunning coincidences very close to home.

The recent revelation of a 49-year-old man's adoption sends Chris searching for answers to a secret his adoptive parents took to the grave; a biracial woman enlists Lisa's help to find her birth family, revealing some unfortunate tragedies.

Stephen Dilbeck gets some shocking information about his birth family from Jane and Lisa; Chris and Sallie work on getting approval of an exhumation that will answer questions for hundreds of Hicks babies.

Lisa helps a man yearning to discover his biological roots, but fearful of rejection from the family he has never met; Chris reveals the truth to a woman who has felt guilty that her birth might have devastated the life of her 14-year-old mom.

Ryan moved to Montana to keep himself from going down a dark path of drug addiction, but his new path may be no less lethal than the last if he can't find a way to curb his eating habits before they kill him.
Bedridden Marla is so heavy she cannot stand up; she must face the hard truth about her condition and understand the toll it takes on her supportive family.
Chay has eaten his way to 600 pounds to cope with the emotional turmoil of his childhood; he loses his emotional support and searches for new strength to take control of his life.

Living with his family, Lucas wants to spread his wings and fly, but at 600 pounds, he can't take off. All he does is eat and game, and if he wants to leave the nest and live a normal life, he needs Dr. Now's help to lose over 400 pounds.

Margaret's life at 700 pounds is in need of a jump-start; at age 35, she is a mama's girl; it's time for Margaret to get out of bed, overcome her food addiction and break away from the comfort of her mother so she can finally live her life.
At 700 pounds, Ontreon has managed to keep going thanks to his faith in God, and he's training to become a minister; Ontreon is hopeful but has to believe in himself.

La serie ligera y divertida de situaciones cómicas producida por la cadena mexicana Televisa, relata las vidas de los habitantes de un edificio de apartamentos y sus relaciones entre ellos, se exploran los conflictos y sucesos divertidos que pueden pasar entre vecinos al tener que vivir cercanamente con gente que tiene personalidades diferentes. Durante cada episodio de 60 minutos se tocan temas en la trama del programa como la envidia, la ambición, el egoísmo, la solidaridad y en general desarrolla temas que pasan a diario en la vida de un ser común. Su creador Eugenio Derbez, también participa como actor y comediante en la serie, junto a él también participan César Bono como Frankie Rivers, Eduardo España como Germán Martínez, Macaria como Magdalena Pérez y Polo Ortín como Don Roque Balboa, entre otros.

Las vicisitudes del Chavo, un niño de 8 años que es huérfano y quien vive en un barril ubicado dentro de una vecindad, y que junto a Quico, la Chilindrina, Ñoño y la Popis experimentan una serie de enredos y graciosas confusiones.

Una serie mexicana de situaciones cómicas que se centra alrededor de la familia López, que está integrada por un grupo colorido de personajes inusuales. El director y productor ejecutivo de la serie humorística es Jorge Ortiz de Pinedo que también protagoniza el papel de Plácido López en la serie, él es el padre y cabeza de esta familia interesante, que vive en un apartamento diminuto, junto a él actúa Zully Keith, quien hace el papel de la esposa abnegada llamada Renata Gonzáles, Eduardo Manzano actúa como Arnoldo López, el padre de Plácido, Mariana Botas interpreta a Martina López, la hija menor, Ricardo Margaleff hace el papel de Plutarco López, el hijo mayor de la pareja, María Fernanda interpreta a Alicia "Licha", la hermana de Renata, Andrea Torre es la Nena, la hija de Alicia, también están otros personajes como Adolfo, el novio de la Nena; Tecla, la indígena adolescente y Don Justo del Valle, el jefe de Plácido.

La serie de situaciones cómicas mexicana, se centra en una familia conformada por Ludovico, protagonizado por Eugenio Derbez, quien es la cabeza de la familia, su esposa, Federica (Consuelo Duval), y sus tres hijos, Junior (Luis Manuel Ávila), Bibi (Regina Blandón) y Ludoviquito (Miguel Pérez). Ellos viven en una ciudad muy particular, la cual está edificada con peluche y todos los accesorios son de peluche también. Ellos son una familia común y corriente que enfrentan problemas comunes, los cuales son representados en el programa de manera exagerada, los conflictos siempre terminan en situaciones divertidas. La comedia de humor original, ligera y única está dirigida para todo el público en general.

Sgt Cryer is reluctant to attend the farewell party organised for him ahead of his retirement. When he decides to go after Conway pays him a visit, the guests are surprised at who he brings along.

Hagen and Hayward pursue a man lurking outside a school who resembles a local paedophile. Meanwhile, PC Hollis intervenes in a fight outside the school and ends up narrowly avoiding a disastrous car crash.

DS McAllister encounters Jamie Ross, her former lover and informant, at a bar after he makes a surprise return to Sun Hill. However, it soon becomes apparent that things may not be as simple as they seem.
As he starts out as Sun Hill's new area car driver, PC Des Taviner makes a poor first impression on account of his rudeness and demand that PC Worrell be removed from duty with him.

It's October 1968, and preparations for Trixie and Matthew's wedding are underway. Nancy makes a home visit to Imelda O'Connor, who is pregnant with her second child, and is surprised that Imelda, her husband Maurice and young son Paul are living in a cramped caravan on a building site.

Nonnatus House is abuzz with excitement as the countdown to Trixie and Matthew's wedding begins. Whilst Sister Veronica has appointed herself in charge of organising the wedding gifts, Trixie's brother, Geoffrey Franklin, arrives from Malta and immediately starts arranging the perfect hen do. However, the approaching nuptials cause stress levels to escalate as a catalogue of small and great disasters threaten to spoil the day.

To help make ends meet, Tilly signs up with Katie Drew to start work at Sopwith's mine. Despite the hard work in the pit, Tilly enjoys it, however just as she gains some semblance of happiness, disaster strikes.
While Hetty investigates the circumstances of a death, Robert and Geoffrey go undercover.

Hetty is asked by the local councillor to help mediate between the council and his mother, who has barricaded herself into her ramshackle flat, and Hetty's investigation soon leads her to uncover bribery and corruption.
Robert begins a new career as a journalist, Geoffrey joins a gym, and Hetty finds a new client - her hairdresser.
When Great Slaughter Cricket Club's arrogant star player is murdered, Sister Boniface must do all she can to catch the killer.

Am Flughafen von Madrid fallen beim Durchleuchten des Gepäcks der Flugpassagiere zwei ungewöhnliche Koffer auf. Auf dem Röntgenbild ist bereits deutlich zu erkennen, dass beide Gepäckstücke modifiziert wurden. Auch das Herkunftsland ist verdächtig.

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Die Milchstraße gilt als nahezu größte Galaxie im Universum. Überraschende Forschungsergebnisse belegen, dass sie womöglich durch ein schwarzes Loch entstanden ist. Das bedeutet, dass schwarze Löcher Materie erschaffen könnten.

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Bereits seit Jahrzehnten wird über die Möglichkeit von Zeitreisen diskutiert. Selbst Albert Einstein glaubt daran, dass nicht alle Uhren im Universum gleich ticken. Diese Sendung befasst sich mit dem Leben von Astronauten und mit Schwarzen Löchern.

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Das leistungsfähige Teleskop des Alma-Observatoriums in Chile lässt Himmelskörper anders entdecken. Dabei haben sie nicht nur bizarre Exoplaneten entdeckt, sondern auch Braune Zwerge, die den Erkenntnisstand über den Kosmos hinten anstellt.

p.t: Das Universum - Eine Reise durch Raum und Zeit
p.d: Die Erde dreht sich nicht nur um die eigene Achse, sondern die elliptische Umlaufbahn um die Sonne spielt ebenfalls eine große Rolle. Wissenschaftler zeichnen die Route einer 4,6 Milliarden Jahre langen Reise nach, um mehr darüber zu erfahren.

Die Flüssigkeit in der Rinde des Uvos-Baums wirkt antibakteriell. Der Saft ist genau das, was EJ jetzt braucht, denn der Outdoor-Crack ist nach seinem langen Marsch durch die Wildnis extrem durstig. Seine Mission hat EJ aber noch nicht erfüllt.

Die letzte Etappe ist besonders anstrengend, denn die meisten Teilnehmer haben einfach keine Kraftreserven mehr. Das wissen Steven, Matt und EJ aus eigener Erfahrung. Und wenn man auf der Zielgeraden ausscheidet, ist das besonders bitter.

p.t: Naked Survival XXL - Überleben in der Kälte
p.d: Tierhäute werden nicht ausreichen, um sich in der Winterlandschaft vor der Kälte zu schützen. Die 3er-Teams müssen ein Feuer entzünden und ihren Unterschlupf abdichten, damit der eisige Wind nicht durch jede Ritze pfeift.

p.t: Naked Survival XXL - Überleben in der Kälte
p.d: Die Bärenspuren in der Nähe des Lagers machen Ky und Gabby sichtlich nervös. Den Raubtieren geht man in der Wildnis besser aus dem Weg. Aber die Profis können sich auch nicht permanent verstecken, denn sie benötigen Feuerholz und Nahrung.

p.t: Naked Survival XXL - Überleben in der Kälte
p.d: Raubkatzen können ihre Krallen einziehen, deshalb stammen die Abdrücke, die Ky und Gabby im Schnee sehen, wahrscheinlich von einem Puma. Das bedeutet, die beiden müssen sehr wachsam sein, wenn sie ihren Unterschlupf verlassen.

p.t: Naked Survival XXL - Überleben in der Kälte
p.d: Die Outdoor-Cracks werden in der Wildnis einem Medizincheck unterzogen und Sarahs Herz schlägt doppelt so schnell wie normal. Die Erklärung dafür liegt auf der Hand, den bei extremer Kälte versucht der Körper die Kerntemperatur zu erhöhen.

p.t: The Hunger Games: The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes
p.d: Years before he becomes the tyrannical president of Panem, 18-year-old Coriolanus Snow remains the last hope for his fading lineage. With the 10th annual Hunger Games fast approaching, the young Snow becomes alarmed when he's assigned to mentor Lucy Gray Baird from District 12. Uniting their instincts for showmanship and political savvy, they race against time to ultimately reveal who's a songbird and who's a snake.

Two con artists have spent 26 years training their only daughter to swindle, scam and steal at every turn. During a desperate and hastily conceived heist, they charm a stranger into joining them, only to have their entire world turned upside down.
Ten things about Keanu Reeves.
Lance Bass, Joey Fatone and mixology expert Melissa Brooke welcome Justin Sylvester to the bar as they challenge the mixologists to battle extreme temperature shifts.

The Real Housewives of New Jersey's Melissa Gorga delivers sweet critiques as the mixologists explore the many cocktails of vacation, starting with the Espresso Martini, at Melissa's request of course.

Our mixology expert, Melissa Brooke, takes us back to the basics with a series of challenges meant to test our mixologists' skills, while Lance and Joey bring along an old friend to join the fun - actor, producer and writer Seth Green.
USA's Everything on the Menu host Braun Strowman stops by to enjoy a flavor explosion on Cocktail Wars, and we find out what the strongest human we know thinks about our menu.
The one and only Lauren Graham drops by to join Joey, Lance and Melissa for coffee, eggs and all things brunch.

In what was once North America, the Capitol of Panem maintains its hold on its 12 districts by forcing them each to select a boy and a girl, called Tributes, to compete in a nationally televised event called the Hunger Games. Every citizen must watch as the youths fight to the death until only one remains. District 12 Tribute Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) has little to rely on, other than her hunting skills and sharp instincts, in an arena where she must weigh survival against love.

After arriving safely home from their unprecedented victory in the 74th Annual Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen (Jennifer Lawrence) and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) discover that they must do a quick turnaround and begin a Victors Tour. As she and Peeta travel throughout the districts, Katniss senses a rebellion is stirring. However, President Snow (Donald Sutherland) proves that he is still very much in control when word comes of a cruel change in the rules for the upcoming 75th Hunger Games.

Following her rescue from the devastating Quarter Quell, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) awakes in the complex beneath the supposedly destroyed District 13. Her home, District 12, has been reduced to rubble, and Peeta Mellark (Josh Hutcherson) is now the brainwashed captive of President Snow (Donald Sutherland). At the same time, Katniss also learns about a secret rebellion spreading throughout all of Panem -- a rebellion that will place her at the center of a plot to turn the tables on Snow.

p.t: Leaders with Francine Lacqua: The Podcast
p.d: Francine conversa con la leyenda del tenis Rafael Nadal sobre la mentalidad que impulsó su extraordinaria carrera. Ambos analizan cómo la resiliencia, las dudas personales y una determinación inquebrantable le ayudaron a superar lesiones recurrentes y a convertirse en uno de los más grandes campeones del tenis.

VivaTech y Bloomberg unen sus fuerzas para crear una nueva plataforma de premios a nivel mundial, con el fin de reconocer no solo a quienes triunfan en el sector tecnológico, sino también a quienes están definiendo el rumbo futuro de la tecnología.
Una conversación a profundidad con Greg Fleming, presidente y director ejecutivo de Rockefeller Capital Management.
