Kevin and Noah smoke up some State Fair Turkey Legs; fry some skillet Chorizo & Eggs; smoke-and-fry some Buffalo Rib Tips; and cook up some Sriracha and Garlic-Butter Grilled Shrimp.
Kevin and Noah are smoking up some BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Coleslaw; frying up a skillet of Creole Cabbage; and charcoal-grilling some Steak Sandwiches with Chimichurri Mayo.

Andrew gives squab the game-day treatment with two bold recipes: crispy Buffalo-style fried squab with blue cheese and ranch, and red chile grilled squab taquitos with green tomatillo salsa, cotija and crema.

Andrew butchers a whole bison leg before diving in to grinding meat for bison brats, grilling them up and topping with homemade spicy mustard. Then, he grills Middle Eastern-inspired kebabs to serve over flatbread for a feast built for sharing.

Andrew tackles suckling pig with two recipes-his take on a three-cup braise with soy, rice wine, and sesame oil, served with plancha fried rice, and a whole pig roasted over open fire and pulled for Philly-style pork sandwiches with broccoli rabe.

Goose, one of Andrew's favorite game birds, is prepared two ways: a French onion soup-style grilled breast sandwich with caramelized onions and melted cheese, and a whole bird, cured, roasted on a beer can, and served with an apple-fennel salad.

Andrew cooks yellowtail two ways: grilled collars with a sweet, savory Filipino-inspired adobo sauce, and grilled filets with miso sauce, shiso butter, and charred vegetables. A lesson in using the whole fish and getting more from every cut.

Andrew takes on "little fish, big fish," cooking grilled whole small fish over Japanese charcoal with sesame spinach, and a larger fish in a bold puttanesca-style dish. Simple techniques, big flavor, and a case for eating lower on the food chain.

Andrew Zimmern creates a vibrant salad where grilled squid is served with shaved fennel, cherry tomatoes, endive, and a lemon dressing. Then, Andrew shares his country-style squid on the plancha with fresh breadcrumbs, chilies, and a homemade aioli.

Chef Andrew Zimmern goes primal with two antelope dishes: a Greek-style whole leg roasted over the open fire with a lemony avgolemono sauce and crispy potatoes, and a simple antelope tenderloin carpaccio served with roasted tomatoes and Parmesan.

Chef Andrew Zimmern starts simmering a classic Italian Bolognese sauce, with ground bison, lots of red wine and tomatoes. Then, he adds marinated bison skirt steak tacos with borracho beans to the tailgate menu.
Andrew Zimmern breaks down a whole rabbit to grill with a spicy, Sichuan sauce and plate with panzanella.
Treat yourself to a five-star pasta dinner, as Frankie cooks his signature dishes with showstopping sauces.

At the end of a long, hectic day, when you need dinner in a pinch, Frankie unlocks his not-so-secret formula for whipping up quick and easy meals, using minimal ingredients that will satisfy your cravings and feed the family in a flash.

There may be infinite ways to define pie, but the only math that matters is what makes these sweet and savory dishes fit the bill. In true Struggle Style, Frankie rolls out his best tips and tricks for enjoying hassle-free, cost-friendly pies.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

Worlds collide when the Flash uses his superpowers to travel back in time to change the events of the past. However, when his attempt to save his family inadvertently alters the future, he becomes trapped in a reality in which General Zod has returned, threatening annihilation. With no other superheroes to turn to, the Flash looks to coax a very different Batman out of retirement and rescue an imprisoned Kryptonian -- albeit not the one he's looking for.

Will Sawyer is a former FBI agent and U.S. war veteran who now assesses security for skyscrapers. While he's on assignment in China, the world's tallest and safest building catches on fire -- and Will gets framed for it. Now a wanted man and on the run, he must find those responsible, clear his name and somehow rescue his family members when they become trapped inside the inferno.

The Jokers are back at Colonial Diner, offering some new bizarre specials to unsuspecting patrons; they take a ride through the park; after a nasty fall, the Joker must get park goers to help them out from underneath their bike.
The Jokers face off by recording voiceover for a fake video game and playing the concerned parent writing to their kid's school; but one Joker burns out with a punishment that's gotta sting.
The jokers are asking strangers to send an important text to their loved ones and hunting for their missing kid using crazy descriptions.

The Jokers are hitting the floor as restaurant owners of a New York Pizzeria, forced to say and do whatever wacky things the other guys tell them to. Later, they're back at Tompkins Square bagels trying to hunt down a customer that left a scathing review. Then, the losing joker is in for a punishment that really sucks.
Monica and Richard experience the same romantic problems as Rachel and Ross; Joey's ill-advised comments to a fan magazine threaten his acting career.
Chandler wants his annoying new roommate (Adam Goldberg) to move out; Joey is facing some exorbitant bills; the girls learn from a book about personal empowerment.
Monica's boyfriend proves to be the life of the party when he attends a basketball game with Chandler and Joey.
Two bullies (Peter DeLuise, Nicky Katt) banish Ross and Chandler from Central Perk; Monica plays the stock market.
Rachel's separated parents (Marlo Thomas, Ron Leibman) unexpectedly attend her surprise birthday party.
Phoebe's romantic meeting with an old friend (Charlie Sheen) is stalled by a case of the chickenpox; Ben celebrates his first birthday; Monica frets about her relationship with Richard (Tom Selleck).
Rachel is a bridesmaid at her ex-fiancé's wedding; she has flashbacks of her own failed wedding day; Monica and Richard's relationship is jeopardized when the subject of children is discussed.

In 1963, with President John F. Kennedy growing more liberal and humanitarian in his policies, a shadowy cabal of Texas oil magnates, hardline conservatives, intelligence agents and rogue operatives meet to discuss possible action. The swaggering Foster (Robert Ryan) wants JFK dead, but the mysterious and powerful Ferguson (Will Geer) rebuffs the idea. Still, Farrington (Burt Lancaster) carries out a military training operation in preparation for an assassination while he waits for a decision.
A dabbler-in-crime (John Houseman) and his assistant (Jacqueline Bisset) hire an ex-police reporter (Charles Bronson) to recover some stolen papers.

In their efforts to avoid capture, Johnny and Steve have numerous misadventures and are aided by the lovely dancing sisters Flo and Sue.

Grady Dodd (Hank Williams Jr.) is a good old country boy with a smile on his face, a guitar on his knee and a song in his heart. His curmudgeonly uncle, Kermit (Ed Begley), may sneer at his nephew's talents, but, after foolishly gambling away all the family's money, Kermit pushes Grady to make some quick cash by recording a song for a local television program. Much to Kermit's surprise and chagrin, Grady's catchy country ditty quickly becomes a hit and hurls him into the spotlight.

Granny gets into a love triangle, with Sam and Bugs both fighting for her hand in marriage; Sam wants Granny's money, and Bugs want to help Granny.

A year after dealing with a surprise engagement in Father of the Bride, Stanley Banks (Spencer Tracy) and his wife, Ellie (Joan Bennett), are in for another shock when they find their daughter Kay (Elizabeth Taylor) is now pregnant. Not ready to be a grandfather, Stanley keeps quiet while everyone else fawns over the mother-to-be and bothers her about baby names and nursery decorations. Ironically, his silence makes him the person Kay turns to the most for help, which in turn helps him.

p.t: Cat on a Hot Tin Roof
p.d: After Brick Pollitt (Paul Newman) injures himself while drunkenly revisiting his high school sports-star days, he and his tempestuous wife, Maggie (Elizabeth Taylor), visit his family's Mississippi plantation for the 65th birthday of his hot-tempered father, Big Daddy (Burl Ives). Cantankerous even with declining health, Big Daddy demands to know why Brick and Maggie haven't yet given him a grandchild, unlike Brick's brother Gooper (Jack Carson) and his fecund wife, Mae (Madeleine Sherwood).

Seana tiene 23 años y pesa 317 kilogramos, vive con su madre y sufre de depresión y ansiedad. Además, su aumento de peso amenaza con quitarle la vida. El Dr. Now puede ayudarla, pero hasta que ella no decida recibir la ayuda, nadie podrá salvarla.
Un huracán de categoría 5 destroza el campamento de Amal y Duke; este par también soporta arañas venenosas, insectos y depredadores nocturnos en los pantanos de Florida.

Abandonados a su suerte en la abrasadora sabana de Guyana, dos personas luchan contra el calor excesivo, los implacables ataques de insectos y la deshidratación severa que los obliga a beber líquidos nada confiables.
Ed prueba sus técnicas de supervivencia en los desiertos de Namibia. Deberá juntar fuerzas para combatir el calor extremo.
Estas son seis de las más duras prisiones del mundo, a tal punto que hasta los jefes de las mafias y asesinos aprenden el significado del miedo.

En Oklahoma, la policía persigue a un presunto traficante de drogas en una autopista. Por su parte, en Michigan, un oficial es atacado por un hombre enmascarado. Además, en Misuri, una operación encubierta falla cuando el sospechoso huye.

Un hombre llega a la frontera con un bebé, pero esconde otro bien valioso. Una pareja no declara unos aguacates mexicanos. Un adolescente que dice ser ciudadano estadounidense llega buscando asistir a una escuela secundaria en Texas.

En Wisconsin, un perro policía salva la vida de unos policías al derribar a un fugitivo armado, pero recibe un disparo en la cabeza. En Connecticut, un policía es atacado durante un robo. En Oklahoma, un choque frontal conduce a una persecución.
Un viajero en una conexión nacional es interrogado sobre el contenido sospechoso de su maleta. Un pasajero distraído corre el riesgo de perder sus pertenencias.

La persecución de la policía a un ladrón de autos termina con un final inesperado. Un policía acude en ayuda de los perros de un sospechoso, pero su acto de bondad es recibido por una lluvia de balas. La pelea de una pareja complica el día.
Los supervivientes enfrentan una prueba crucial en balsa y las familias en la sede forman nuevas alianzas tras una extracción que cambia el rumbo del juego.

Un antiguo hospital en el sur de Pittsburgh, Tennessee, fue en el pasado un faro de esperanza, pero ahora alberga a los espíritus de los muertos, incluida una entidad, similar a un perro, llamada Creeper.
Una lesión pone en riesgo la continuidad de Maci y Justin en la selva nicaragüense, donde tienen que sobrevivir durante catorce días.

Un surfista de Hawái y un ex militar intentan sobrevivir en mitad de la naturaleza, en Texas. Rodeados de armadillos, agresivos jabalíes y carneros de las Rocosas, combaten además contra el hambre y la lluvia torrencial.
Una joven rebelde y un sargento retirado son abandonados en la selva de Belice después del paso de un huracán catastrófico que pondrá en peligro su aventura.

Michel se disfrazó de Kory y se presentó a un examen con la intención de ayudarla, pero fue descubierto y ambos fueron sancionados y expulsados del sistema educativo.
Su esposo quiere despedir a la doula por insistir en un embarazo al margen de médicos. Los celos y favoritismo de su novia y supervisora fueron la causa de que la tuviera que despedir.
Le dan somníferos para que se mantenga delgada y pueda modelar. Practicaba sexo extremo con la hermana de su esposa, ella muere y le deja una herencia que no puede cobrar por estar involucrado.
Rafael es un hombre muy bueno y dueño de una carpintería. Pero a su alrededor solo tiene a gente falsa que lo quiere ver caer. Con mucha fe, él podrá solucionar los problemas y las deudas.
Martín es un campeón de natación y está enamorado de Valeria. El padre de él está obsesionado con que se convierta en un medallista y no acepta la relación.

Francesco le ofrece un futuro romántico a Teresa: sueña con pasear con ella por Roma, acompañados de Sofía, quien se da cuenta de que Lupo y su mamá están hablando y estalla, llena de rabia. Epifanio quiere casarse con Veva, le pese a quien le pese.
Las Pernas llegan a México con sed de venganza, no pueden perder tiempo y buscan de inmediato a Teresa. Ella contraataca y ejecuta un plan contra el Zurdo Villa y sus enemigos gallegos.
Vicky muere después de la cesárea y Lucía, con el corazón roto, le comunica a su familia. Octavio, Daniel y Lucha sienten que no fue un accidente, aunque son otros quienes pueden asegurarlo.
Daniel detiene a Rafael por un testimonio del que no tiene evidencias, Radamés y Montes conspiran y el infiltrado actúa. Lucía tiene un sueño revelador cuando se muda obligada por su esposo.

New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

p.t: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
p.d: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? When bloodthirsty, undead ghouls invade their once-peaceful town, it's up to kindhearted Ben, quick-witted Carter and class clown Augie to save the day. With help from Denise (Sarah Dumont), a beautiful but tough cocktail waitress, the boys must put their scouting skills to the ultimate test to save mankind and earn their zombie-killing badges.

In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters.

In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next.

Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down.
A grieving mother who thinks her child is reaching out to her from beyond holds a seance to communicate and unwittingly unleashes evil in her home.

While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss.

New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.
A perfect destination wedding to Nicaragua is derailed as people get drunk and debauched, and the mischief is recorded by guests with video cameras.

p.t: Scouts Guide to the Zombie Apocalypse
p.d: What could possibly go wrong when three buddies (Tye Sheridan, Logan Miller, Joey Morgan) decide to join the Boy Scouts? When bloodthirsty, undead ghouls invade their once-peaceful town, it's up to kindhearted Ben, quick-witted Carter and class clown Augie to save the day. With help from Denise (Sarah Dumont), a beautiful but tough cocktail waitress, the boys must put their scouting skills to the ultimate test to save mankind and earn their zombie-killing badges.

In her many years as a social worker, Emily Jenkins (Renée Zellweger) thinks she has seen it all -- until she meets 10-year-old Lilith (Jodelle Ferland) and the girl's cruel parents. When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters.

In 2013, the United States president was exiling all citizens who don't conform to his hyper-conservative views to Los Angeles, which became an island after a huge earthquake. But, when the president's daughter nabs the detonator to her dad's apocalyptic weapon and sneaks into L.A. to be with the rebel leader she loves, the government taps commando-turned-crook Snake Plissken to retrieve the young woman. And, if he doesn't succeed quickly, he'll be executed.

When the Reys move into their new Southern California home, little do they realize that the house is already occupied. After coming home one day to find the house in disarray -- but with no signs of forced entry or robbery -- they install a video surveillance system to catch the perpetrators. But nothing prepares them for what happens next.

An idea from a young, new co-worker (Anna Kendrick) would put an end to the constant travel of corporate downsizer Ryan Bingham (George Clooney), so he takes her on a tour to demonstrate the importance of face-to-face meetings with those they must fire. While mentoring his colleague, he arranges hookups with another frequent-flier (Vera Farmiga), and his developing feelings for the woman prompt him to see others in a new light.

Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too.

After a job goes horribly wrong, a man who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city while keeping his dark secret hidden.

When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

In the 25th century, the Earth's population has dwindled to a surviving five million following a devastating virus that almost resulted in the extinction of all human life 400 years earlier. Confined to one city-state, a group of rebels, led by Handler (Frances McDormand), seeks to destroy the oppressive government -- first, by assassinating a high-ranking chairman (Marton Csokas). Tasked with this mission, Aeon Flux (Charlize Theron) must integrate herself in a world of deceit and mystery.

After 20 years away, Odysseus washes up on the shores of Ithaca, haggard and unrecognizable. The king finds much has changed since he left to fight in the Trojan War. His beloved wife, Penelope, is a prisoner in her own home and hounded to choose a new husband. Their son faces death at the hands of suitors who see him as an obstacle in their pursuit of Penelope and the kingdom. Odysseus is no longer the mighty warrior his people remember, but he must face his past to save his family.

When the parents try to harm the child, Emily assumes custody of Lilith while looking for a foster family. However, she soon finds that dark forces surround the seemingly innocent child, and the more she tries to protect Lilith, the more horrors she encounters.

After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

Desperate to raise money for his daughter's cancer treatment, a retired bull rider teams up with his estranged son to orchestrate a robbery. However, they must soon outwit the local police if they want to keep the cash and their freedom.

A couple and their four children are forced to abandon their pickup in the midst of ferocious floods outside Baton Rouge, La., while the parents of a 22-year-old daughter search for her in the rubble of a deadly tornado outbreak in southern Illinois.
A fresh coat of snow helps investigators uncover secrets and lies surrounding the brutal murder of an aspiring nurse.
The mutilated body of an unknown woman washes to the surface of a creek in Spring Valley, N.Y.
Afters a storm rolls through a small town in Maine, a beloved teenager is found brutally murdered.

In the late 17th century, accused witch, Moll Dyer, was burned out of her home with flames and fury during a deadly freeze. Legend says she froze to death moments after cursing the town in a vengeful rage.

Legend has it that in the early 1800s a young man wearing a long gray coat rushed home to see his true love on Pawley's Island, South Carolina. He perished in the pluff mud while attempting to cross at high tide.

p.t: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
p.d: The sequel to the Golden Globe-nominated and AFI Award-winning "The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring," "The Two Towers" follows the continuing quest of Frodo and the Fellowship to destroy the One Ring. Frodo and Sam discover they are being followed by the mysterious Gollum. Aragorn, the Elf archer Legolas and Gimli the Dwarf encounter the besieged Rohan kingdom, whose once great King Theoden has fallen under Saruman's deadly spell.
The team must take down a dangerous drug ring after an American diplomat is killed while being used as a pawn; Jubal and OA try to help friends from their past fight off their inner demons.

When a controversial senior leader from Egypt comes to New York for a heart transplant, OA struggles to balance his personal opinion with his professional duty when he is assigned to the security detail.

After a decorated FBI agent is murdered, the team investigates and learns that the man led a double life; Maggie struggles with what information she should reveal to the agent's widow, who is also her personal friend.

A woman who has information about the death of Maggie's husband is abducted, leading OA and the team to uncover a criminal operation larger than anyone imagined; Dana puts her career in jeopardy when she allows Maggie to work on the case.
After a bomb detonates at a restaurant in Queens, the case becomes personal for OA, who grew up eating there; OA goes undercover to prevent another incident.

After the son of a prominent blogger is kidnapped, the team must sweep through her two million followers to find the culprit; Kristen continues to adjust to life as a field agent with her new partner Stuart Scola.

After a female presidential candidate, Valerie Caldwell, is targeted with a car bomb, OA and Maggie must find them before they strike again; the case leads them to wonder if she is being targeted for her political aspirations or something else.

Foster kid Roger (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) loves the Anaheim ⚾ [MLB] Angels, even though they're the worst team in the major leagues. His estranged dad promises to reunite the family if the ⚾ [MLB] Angels make it to the World Series, so Roger decides to ask for some divine help and prays that his favorite team will turn things around. Soon, a real angel named Al (Christopher Lloyd) shows up in response to Roger's prayers, and Anaheim's hopeless coach (Danny Glover) is shocked to see his team on a winning streak.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

El cirujano Danny decide contratar a su ayudante Katherine, una madre soltera con hijos, para que finjan ser su familia. Su intención es demostrarle a Palmer que su amor por ella es tan grande que está a punto de divorciarse de su mujer.
Robby ayuda a un par de hermanos a afrontar el testamento vital de su longevo padre. Más tarde, Samira se deshace de unos policías que persiguen a una mujer.

Rusty Griswold, recordando con cariño los viajes de su infancia a Walley World, sorprende a su mujer y a sus dos hijos con una excursión al parque de atracciones favorito de Estados Unidos. Siguiendo los pasos de su padre, Rusty y su pandilla toman el auto y se lanzan a la carretera para disfrutar de la tan necesaria unión familiar. Pronto, la promesa de diversión se convierte en una desventura tras otra para la nueva generación de Griswolds y para cualquiera que se cruce con ellos.

p.t: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
p.d: The sequel to the Golden Globe-nominated and AFI Award-winning "The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring," "The Two Towers" follows the continuing quest of Frodo and the Fellowship to destroy the One Ring. Frodo and Sam discover they are being followed by the mysterious Gollum. Aragorn, the Elf archer Legolas and Gimli the Dwarf encounter the besieged Rohan kingdom, whose once great King Theoden has fallen under Saruman's deadly spell.
The team must take down a dangerous drug ring after an American diplomat is killed while being used as a pawn; Jubal and OA try to help friends from their past fight off their inner demons.

When a controversial senior leader from Egypt comes to New York for a heart transplant, OA struggles to balance his personal opinion with his professional duty when he is assigned to the security detail.

After a decorated FBI agent is murdered, the team investigates and learns that the man led a double life; Maggie struggles with what information she should reveal to the agent's widow, who is also her personal friend.

A woman who has information about the death of Maggie's husband is abducted, leading OA and the team to uncover a criminal operation larger than anyone imagined; Dana puts her career in jeopardy when she allows Maggie to work on the case.
After a bomb detonates at a restaurant in Queens, the case becomes personal for OA, who grew up eating there; OA goes undercover to prevent another incident.

After the son of a prominent blogger is kidnapped, the team must sweep through her two million followers to find the culprit; Kristen continues to adjust to life as a field agent with her new partner Stuart Scola.

After a female presidential candidate, Valerie Caldwell, is targeted with a car bomb, OA and Maggie must find them before they strike again; the case leads them to wonder if she is being targeted for her political aspirations or something else.

Foster kid Roger (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) loves the Anaheim ⚾ [MLB] Angels, even though they're the worst team in the major leagues. His estranged dad promises to reunite the family if the ⚾ [MLB] Angels make it to the World Series, so Roger decides to ask for some divine help and prays that his favorite team will turn things around. Soon, a real angel named Al (Christopher Lloyd) shows up in response to Roger's prayers, and Anaheim's hopeless coach (Danny Glover) is shocked to see his team on a winning streak.

Jonas Taylor leads a research team on an exploratory dive into the deepest depths of the ocean. Their voyage spirals into chaos when a malevolent mining operation threatens their mission and forces them into a high-stakes battle for survival. Pitted against colossal, prehistoric sharks and relentless environmental plunderers, they must outrun, outsmart and outswim their merciless predators.

His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.

Remembering fond, childhood memories of his trip to Walley World, Rusty Griswold surprises his wife and two sons with a cross-country excursion to America's favorite fun park. Following in his father's footsteps, Rusty and the gang pack up the car and hit the road for some much-needed family bonding. Soon, the promise of fun turns into one misadventure after another for the next generation of Griswolds and anyone who encounters them.

When retiring police Detective William Somerset (Morgan Freeman) tackles a final case with the aid of newly transferred David Mills (Brad Pitt), they discover a number of elaborate and grizzly murders. They soon realize they are dealing with a serial killer (Kevin Spacey) who is targeting people he thinks represent one of the seven deadly sins. Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city.

Chaos reigns when members of a dysfunctional family gather to bury a loved one. Son Daniel (Matthew MacFadyen) anticipates a face-off with his famous brother Robert (Rupert Graves), while cousin Martha (Daisy Donovan) and her fiancé Simon (Alan Tudyk) are desperate to make a good impression on her father. In the midst of the family turmoil, a mystery guest threatens to bring the deceased's skeleton out of the closet.

Young Keda tries to survive alone in the wilderness after he's left for dead during his first hunt with his Cro-Magnon tribe. He soon forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, Keda and the wolf must now trek through a harsh and unforgiving landscape to make it home before winter.

Jaime Reyes suddenly finds himself in possession of an ancient relic of alien biotechnology called the Scarab. When the Scarab chooses Jaime to be its symbiotic host, he's bestowed with an incredible suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary and unpredictable powers, forever changing his destiny as he becomes the superhero Blue Beetle.

A magical board game unleashes a world of adventure on siblings Peter and Judy Shepherd. While exploring an old mansion, the youngsters find a curious, jungle-themed game called Jumanji in the attic. When they start playing, they free Alan Parrish, who's been stuck in the game's inner world for decades. If they win Jumanji, the kids can free Alan for good, but that means braving giant bugs, ill-mannered monkeys and even stampeding rhinos!

p.t: Journey to the Center of the Earth
p.d: During an expedition to Iceland, professor Trevor Anderson (Brendan Fraser), his nephew Sean (Josh Hutcherson) and their guide, Hannah (Anita Briem), get trapped in a cavern. As they follow their only escape route deeper and deeper below the Earth's surface, they pass through strange places and encounter incredible creatures, including dinosaurs. But as volcanic activity around them increases, they realize they must find their way out -- soon.

Scott and Kate Johansen must figure out a way to earn some money after their daughter's scholarship falls through. When all else fails, the desperate couple join forces with their neighbor Frank to start an underground casino in his home. As the cash rolls in and the good times fly, Scott and Kate soon learn that they may have bitten off more than they can chew.

Sal, Murr, Joe, and Q play matchmakers at the food court; the Jokers pose as architects, sharing some perplexing new building technology; the night's big loser makes a connection while networking -- and won't let go.

Q, Joe, Murr and Sal find scandalous diary entries written by their daughters; then break up with significant others in front of baffled strangers; the loser finds himself in hot water and on shaky ground while waiting tables.

The guys pitch their whimsical TV show ideas to focus groups; they go to the park with their daughters who share unpopular opinions with strangers; the loser heads to the spa for an electrifying punishment two years in the making.
Daredevil stunts go awry for two base jumpers, a ski jumper, drivers in fiery crashes and more; celebrity commentators include Danny Bonaduce, Judy Gold and Tonya Harding.
Dumbest partiers; a drinking contest leaves participants doused in beer; a bad break-dancer lands in an emergency room; a drunk Russian woman performs an impromptu striptease for arresting officers.
NBA stars Richard Jefferson and Channing Frye join Casey Jost to shoot hoops at Joe, Q, Murr and Sal's alma mater, Monsignor Farrell High School, and rate the guys' performances of past seasons.

Sal, Murr, Q and Joe climb to the Top of the Rock for some awkward interactions, then "whet" their appetites at a bagel shop; the evening's loser takes a run across the Brooklyn Bridge that is anything but inspiring.
Joe, Sal, Q, and Murr pose as waiting room receptionists and then pitch to a focus group; things get interesting on a road trip that drives tonight's loser to the edge.
Joe, Sal, Q, and Murr pose as documentary subjects; the guys go looking for fights in a public park; one joker must crash a poetry slam.
The guys play receptionist for the day; teaching parents proper home-schooling techniques; dreams come true as one joker lands the endorsement deal of a lifetime.
The boys learn how hard it is to find good help these days; the guys return to their artistic roots; one joker reluctantly delivers a series of crushing blows.
The guys get greedy with fellow shoppers at the market, then offer major disservices to a focus group; tonight's big loser learns that the grass is always pinker on the other side.

Q, Joe, Sal and Murr pose as avant-garde photographers in a Staten Island park and get fully animated when pitching to a focus group; just when tonight's big loser thinks it's in the bag, he still comes out painfully behind.

When a sponsorship of Clarence's school turns into an ominous corporate takeover, Clarence must stand up to the man. Clarence is in the doctor's waiting room.

p.d: When Gumball and Darwin realize that Sarah is no longer their number one fan, they try to get her attention back by whatever means possible; Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.
Mordecai and Rigby are two best friends who work and live in a local park. They have to unload a load of boba.
Finn meets his adventuring role model. A new Nice King has arrived in Ooo, and he bears a striking resemblance to someone we know.
In order to find out about his family history, Robin takes a DNA test and discovers he's from Babylon.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
p.d: Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.
Mordecai and Rigby can't sleep because of the beep. The guys call an old friend to get the party started.

Muscle Man makes a song for Starla and tries to get it playing on his favourite radio station. Rigby and Mordecai participate in a donut eating contest for a chance to feature in their favourite police show.
What is a teen superhero's everyday life when the cape comes off? Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg deal with the usual issues of adolescence while trying to save the world.

Clarence is a spirited boy who sees the best in everything and tackles the problems of everyday life with enthusiasm alongside his friends, Jeff and Sumo. Dirt fights and secret tree forts are all par for the course for Clarence.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball

Skips must decrease his stress levels before it destroys him. Thomas has a brain freeze and the guys must save him.

The Farmer is sick in bed, and with Bitzer playing nursemaid, it's down to Shaun to handle the daily chores around the farm, with disastrous results.

The Baron and Penfold are stranded together on King Kong Brunel's desert island. In the skies above the island, the Mark IV and the Frog's Head Flyer are in a race to snatch Brunel's All Encompassing Remote Control.

Professor von Screwtop gets mistaken for the new kid in school and joins Class 3C for the day. Rubi is so embarrassed at her dad's antics that she resorts to pranking to get him into trouble and out of the way.

After a muddy race the spectators wait with anticipation to see who is revealed as the winner.

Gumball and Darwin barely survive a school picnic in the Forest of Doom.
After Ivandoe and Bert rescue Jezebel the thief, Ivandoe falls in love with her again and agrees to get her the invaluable Tears of Triumph, a miracle cure for every illness.
The cast of the new UK tour of High School Musical perform a show-stopping song.
Squabbling scientists and sneaky supervillains - it's the Horrible Science Big Bang Prom!

A team of five friends from East Sussex attempt to walk away with a big cash prize.

Today, Hannah, Jay and Sinead each hope to win fifty thousand pounds as they guess the familiar phrases hidden in animated clues.

All that stands between Julie, Dhiren, Emma and Christopher and thousands of pounds is the not-so-small matter of one of the country's finest quiz brains.
Liam, Pen, Gaynor and Mel work together to try to take down one of the country's finest quiz brains. Bradley Walsh hosts as they try to overcome the Chaser for thousands of pounds.
Toyah Willcox, John Barnes, Germaine Greer and Audley Harrison join forces in the hope that they have the knowledge to beat one of the country's finest quiz brains.
Guests include Coronation Street's Hayley Tamaddon, Football Hero Sir Geoff Hurst, Comedian Rob Beckett and TV Presenter Gaby Roslin.

The Simpsons throw a Halloween party where Lisa, Grampa and Bart each tell a scary story. A Krusty the Clown doll comes alive and terrorises Homer, Montgomery Burns travels to Skull Island to catch giant ape 'King Homer', and Bart accidentally wakes all the human dead in Springfield.
Bart auditions to play Fallout Boy when Springfield is chosen as the location for Rainier Wolfcastle's big-screen adaptation of 'Radioactive Man', but he comes up a little short.

When Krusty the Klown's network show gets cancelled, Bart and Lisa unite to get him back on TV by enlisting some of Krusty's celebrity friends to appear on a comeback special. On the guest list are Bette Midler, Hugh Hefner, the Red Hot Chili Peppers, Elizabeth Taylor, Johnny Carson and Luke Perry. After the show the celebrities head for Moe's to hang out together.
Coach falls in love with a woman he has never seen before, and decides he will propose to her. Coach's new woman has a beautiful daughter and Sam tries his best to take her on a date.
The gang is furious when Irene dumps Coach after she wins the lottery, but when Coach refuses to believe that Irene is really gone, everyone worries that he's living in a state of denial.
After sharing a very pleasant dinner with Frasier's famous psychologist mother, Diane is stunned when Frasier's mother quietly threatens to kill Diane if she doesn't leave him alone.
Debra's hippie sister, Jennifer, visits Ray and Debra's home and announces she has decided to become a nun.
Ray is upset when Debra says he is just like his cousin Gerard, and he thinks it would be a good idea to turn to his family for reassurance.
Debra spends a whole day cooking with Marie in an effort to get along with her mother-in-law, and Ray reluctantly agrees to take Robert and Frank to a car show.
Lisa makes a warts-and-all documentary about life with her family. Though the flick is a Sundance success, it turns the Simpsons into national hate figures.
When Homer learns he needs a heart bypass operation after having a heart attack at work, he searches for the cheapest doctor.
Magic man Penn Jillette chats about his UK tour. Beverley Knight tells us about the theatre show `Sylvia: A Musical Revolution'. Plus: Lara Pulver, Jay Sean, Xand van Tulleken, and Bloc Party.
Julia battles cracked plaster and expensive surprises during her bridal bedroom refurb. Anna and Edward get creative with candles. Debbie and Nigel transform an old piano into a gin bar.

The competition begins at Home Farm B&B in Milton Keynes, where couple Nick and Tim hope their inexperience in the hospitality game won't be a barrier to success. The accommodation impresses, but two guests have sizeable concerns about space.

The week's second visit is to Cricklade in Wiltshire, where Iain and Tayla host at The Vale Hotel. Their breakfast-free, no-frills ethos worries some of the guests, but it's the proximity to a main road that causes the most concern for one pair.

When the Ruff-Ruff Pack steals Mr. Porter's mini-donut maker, the Moto Pups set off to get the machine back in one piece.
The Mixmups go on an adventure to find out what the clouds taste like. When they can't reach up to the sky, the Mixmups work together to try and find another way to discover how they taste.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

It's Peppa Pig's birthday so she awakens very early. First, Peppa gets a present from Mummy, Daddy and George, and then it's time for her party. Daddy Pig does some funny magic tricks and makes a birthday cake appear with four candles for Peppa to blow out.
Daddy Pig gets a new movie camera. Peppa shows him how to work it, and then he records Peppa saying hello. Everyone laughs when they see Peppa on TV.

Milo, Lofty and Lark become ambulance drivers for the day and soon realise that driving fast is not right for all patients. When Tania needs to get to the hospital to have her baby, Milo has to put his foot down.
When Nia causes an accident that sends sand into Tess's gears during a big delivery, Nia tries Sandy's new super-grease as a solution.
When Peter creates a wild and adventurous trail for Scoop Dooley to follow, they both end up getting lost.
Paddington makes Goo, but struggles to keep his promise to not make a mess.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim, Kai and Tommy try to get their ball back from Mum's bedroom.
Pip and Posy give out medals for winning their games. When Zac joins in, he isn't very good, but they fix the games for him to win. But Zac gets upset as he wants to earn the medals.
When Pip and Posy are having a 'bad mood day', Jamila encourages them to climb the 'happiness hill'. As they climb, they begin to have fun again and banish the bad mood day forever.

Peppa and family continue driving across America to get to Hollywood. As they drive through the desert, they meet Mr. Buffalo and Mr. Bison who are doing road work just like Mr. Bull from back home. They meet another Miss Rabbit and fly over the Grand Canyon in a helicopter, white water raft through the rapids and discover a cave from 700AD.
Need a fix of 90s club classics? Lock in for a marathon of memories as we take you back to the greatest decade of dance! The 90s!
Get yourself feeling all continental with a dose of the greatest Eurodance medicine around. Clubland gives you the biggest 30!
The definitive floor fillers from '95 to '99, a time when stomping beats and euphoric breakdowns ruled. Fasten your seat-belts and hold on tight, it's going to get bumpy!
Beginning with Diana Ross in 1986 and finishing with Bebe Rexha in 2026, we span an incredible five decades of the never-ending journey of dance!
No excuses, stop what you are doing, turn it up and party hard with the biggest anthems and future classics of the 2020s!
Which late 2010s tracks have racked up over a billion streams worldwide? Think Kygo, DJ Snake, Marshmello and Major Lazer in the mix!

Die vier Freunde halten es für eine gute Idee, eine Firma zu gründen. Sie nennen das Start-up "The Washington Redskins". Natürlich ist das Chaos vorprogrammiert.

South Park wird glutenfrei, nachdem Mr. Mackey damit angefangen hat und allen erzählt, wie toll er sich fühlt. Als alle feststellen, was Gluten dem Körper antun, schließt sich die ganze Stadt an, und keiner weiß mehr, was er essen darf und was nicht.
Eric Cartman ist sich sicher, dass Wendy Testaburger lesbisch ist. Randy hat ein Geheimnis.

Bob freut sich auf ein Thanksgiving-Festmahl mit seiner Familie, doch Linda möchte den Feiertag bei Herrn Fischoeder verbringen, der ein Truthahn-Stadtfest geplant hat. Eine Vogel-Attacke sorgt dort jedoch für Chaos und Bob erfreut sich an der Ruhe.
Bob nimmt an einem Burger-Wettbewerb teil. Die Kinder versuchen, Bob zu helfen.

Weihnachten steht ganz im Zeichen des Wettbewerbs: Jedes der Kinder bemüht sich, das beste Geschenk für ihren Vater zu finden und in der Küche konkurrieren Bob und sein Vater. Ein alter Streit ist die Wurzel allen Übels.

Auch wenn Tina die Gruppe der Thundergirls verlassen möchte, tritt die Leiterin Ginny an sie heran, um einen Spion in den eigenen Reihen ausfindig zu machen, der Informationen an Konkurrenten weitergibt. Tina geht für diese Aufgabe undercover.
Linda schmückt die Wände im Restaurant mit dekorierten Servietten der Kunden.

Roger und Klaus beginnen eine Affäre. Sie haben sich beim Onlinedating kennengelernt. Außerdem will Steve mit allen Mitteln dem Sporttest entgehen und versucht, sich bei Hayley anzustecken, die eine Bindehautentzündung hat.

Stan ist ein gesuchter Mann. Kopfgeldjäger Roger ist hinter ihm her. Auf seiner Flucht landet Stan in einer Kleinstadt, die dringend Hilfe braucht. Stan steht dort Schuldirektor Lewis, Steve, Francine und Hayley unterstützend zur Seite.

Stan ist ziemlich nervös, weil die Terror-Alarmstufe erhöht wurde und "sie" überall sein könnten. Derweil verkündet Steve, dass er das begehrteste Mädchen seiner Schule, Cheerleader Lisa Silver, zu einem Date einladen will und kommt schnell zu dem Schluss, dass ihm dabei ein Hund nützlich sein könnte.

Francine steigt zur erfolgreichen Immobilienmaklerin auf, was Stan in seiner Männlichkeit kränkt, weil sie plötzlich weit mehr als er verdient. Um den Status quo wieder herzustellen, ist Stan zu den radikalsten Mitteln bereit, inklusive eines Kidnappings ins berüchtigte Gefangenencamp Guantánamo.
Hal ist mit seinem Einkommen nicht zufrieden und nimmt daher einen zweiten Job an. Seine Söhne sind darüber zunächst froh, doch dann bestellt ihr Vater einen Babysitter für sie.

Mr Bean goes Christmas shopping, conducts a Salvation Army band, and has Christmas dinner with his long-suffering girlfriend.
Mr Bean treats himself to a weekend at a posh hotel where he manages to get himself into one embarrassing situation after another.

Joey is thrilled when his name is used in a 'Soap Opera Digest' crossword puzzle. He is reluctant to let the magazine do a profile of him, but Rachel tries to persuade him to reconsider so that he can mention her.

Monica and Phoebe host Rachel's baby shower but forget to invite her mother. Rachel realises she is clueless about caring for the baby after birth. Meanwhile, Joey auditions to host a new game show called 'Bamboozled'.

When Monica's cooking at the restaurant receives a harsh write-up in a newspaper, she goes to a criticism class taught by the reviewer, hoping to convince him to reconsider his opinion. Meanwhile, Rachel gets upset when a cute salesgirl flirts with Ross while he and Rachel are shopping for baby supplies, and nervous about a major job interview, Chandler receives some questionable coaching from Phoebe.
Eight days overdue, Rachel grows irritable, prompting a bet between Monica and Phoebe. Meanwhile, Joey invites Chandler to his new film's screening.
Rachel waits in the hospital maternity ward with an anxious Ross. To her dismay, she is put in a semi-private room. Then, the heavily pregnant Janice is assigned to share the room with her.
Rachel doubts Ross's commitment to her and the baby. Meanwhile, Ross wants to confess his love for Rachel. Joey discovers Ross's mother's engagement ring on the floor.

Due to a misunderstanding, Rachel finds herself engaged to Joey instead of Ross shortly after giving birth to her and Ross's baby girl. Meanwhile, Joey can't help taking a look as Rachel tries unsuccessfully to nurse her baby. Inspired to have a baby of their own, Monica and Chandler retire to a hospital cupboard for a little privacy.
Iain is joined by Joel Dommett, Stevie Martin and Desiree Burch to ruthlessly mock internet nonsense from bizarre trends to wild opinions.
Unbeknownst to Debra, beautiful neighbours are the real reasons that Ray is spending so much time at Robert's flat.
Marie and Frank devastate Ray by trading in their gift, a personally engraved toaster, for a coffee maker.
Ray and Robert are roped in to make a film to celebrate Frank being elected Man of the Year at his lodge, but are shocked to discover none of his lodge friends likes him.

Frank gets injured before going on a Caribbean cruise with Marie, so Ray stands in for him, sharing a tiny cabin with his mother, and being mistaken for her lover. Back home, Robert has to look after Frank.

Robbie Coltrane examines the case of two brothers who murdered a marketing manager on Christmas Eve 2014 using chloroform.

Recounting the harrowing story of 11-year-old Wesley Neailey, who was befriended and then brutally raped and murdered by psychopathic 18-year-old Dominic McKilligan.

One wintry day in France in 1999, Evelyn Lund leaves the home of her close friend, and vanishes. The following month her second husband Robert Lund reports her missing and French police begin their search for Evelyn.
In 2015 a man visits a tarot card reader. Within an hour she's dealt out the death card, and he's confessed to a murder.

In 1993, 16-year-old Claire Tiltman is found dying by the roadside. Her killer disappears into the night. More than 20 years later, Colin Ash Smith is finally brought to trial. Jurors hear of how he knew Claire.
A wife vanishes after her husband moves his mistress into the family home. Ten years later a yachting accident reveals the dark truth behind the woman's disappearance.
Documentary examining the terrible truth about the death of loving wife Colette Daffin, mowed down in a hit-and-run accident in Derbyshire 2009.
Examining the sex abuse scandal which occurred in the North of England and appeared to go undetected for quite some time.

John Sweeney brutally murdered two of his girlfriends, dismembered their bodies and dumped them in canals. In a macabre twist, he hid clues in his abstract paintings, and five other girlfriends of his are currently still missing.
Tyler Kerry travelled to Turkey with his family to make memories. Days later, he vanished from their hotel. When his body is found, questions remain over what happened.
While in Jamaica, aspiring model and filmmaker Desiree fell victim to a deadly attack. To date, no arrests have been made as her family desperately seek answers.
A family holiday to Aruba turns into every parent's nightmare when 14-year-old Max DeVries vanishes during a jet ski trip and never returns.

Nika and Chris fight machine breakdowns and water problems, but a new crew member may turn their fortunes around.

All the thrills and spills from the 2013 Red Bull Soapbox Race in London, as the crews unleash their four-wheeled, motorless creations on a downhill course littered with obstacles.

Bob Mortimer returns to his childhood roots in Middlesbrough to fish the River Esk and Tees with his dear friend and angling mentor Paul Whitehouse. As well as trying to catch the glorious grayling, Bob is also going to try to ignite the joy of Christmas in Paul, who thinks the magic of the season has been long-lost to commercialism.
Lee Mack is joined by Dr Christian Jessen and Diane Parish, and David Mitchell is joined by Gabby Logan and Andy Hamilton.
Lee Mack is joined by Bob Mortimer and Patsy Kensit and David Mitchell is joined by Greg Davies and Richard Osman.

Rob Brydon is back in the host's chair for the seventh series of the comedy panel show. As ever, David Mitchell and Lee Mack are the lightning-quick team captains. Over the course of each show, celebrity guests reveal amazing stories about themselves, some of which are true and some of which are not. In this episode, Lee and David are joined by Rhod Gilbert, Vernon Kay, Dara O Briain and Denise Van Outen.

Simon Reeve continues his travels along the Tropic of Capricorn, the line of latitude that cuts across South Africa, South America and Australia. On the Australian west coast, Simon witnesses the migration of the humpback whale. He meets a tough outback couple refusing to leave an asbestos polluted ghost town and a farmer attempting to eke a living out of a dust bowl.
Guy goes to work one mile below the North Sea in the UK's last deep mine.

Mike hunts down an early SUV, a 1970 International Harvester Scout 800A. Ant's repair includes rebuilding a leaky transfer case and replacing the interior to restore it to its former glory.

Mike and Ant answer questions from fans all around the globe. In the process, they reveal to their fans the inner workings of the series and look back at the last eight cars and what they have achieved.
Mike finds a rare beast, a 1976 Mercury Capri MK2 with the classic 2.8 litre V6. However, it's not without its problems which means a lot of work for Ant.
The pinnacle of BMW is the modern classic, the E46 M3. Mike finds one with the subframe already fixed, and he challenges Ant to transform the transmission with new tech.

The Volvo Amazon 122 is a classic Swedish auto with true rally heritage. Mike travels to the Pacific Northwest, where he has tracked down a true barn find. Ant is tasked to make it roadworthy before the boys know the true scope of the work ahead.
Mike gets his hands dirty preparing the Bronco for the biggest collector car auction in the world, Barrett Jackson.
Typically, our journey with off-grid builds ends with the final nail; we're catching up with a couple in Georgia and a family in Tennessee's Smoky Mountains.
A couple looks to build an eco-friendly, off-the-grid geodesic dome, cooled using geothermal caves, with a view of Tennessee's South Cumberland Mountain Range.
A musician and college student wants an off-the-grid treehouse compound with three structures, each serving living and sustainability, in the Arkansas woods.

The Raneys find a Montana homestead struggling through food, predator and power problems. Marty and Matt reunite them with old firefighter squad mates who help consolidate and build out a couple's homestead for safety and accessibility.

The Raneys rescue a single-father homesteader facing threats of rock slides and bears in a Montana box canyon. But with Matt in Alaska awaiting the birth of his daughter, Marty and Misty face an uphill battle.

Homesteaders too proud to admit failure are surprised when loved ones secretly call for an intervention. Facing a new range of challenges and emotions, the Raneys must race to save not just the homestead, but often the fractured families themselves.
A client from Houston wants his old '66 C-10 fused with the best of a '60s Impala. This ground-up build has a hand-built chassis, 6.2L engine and a hydraulic bed.

Henry and stand-in searcher Guy are in Wiltshire visiting collectors Adam and Dan who have an assortment of trucks, tractors, and rare American cars.

Henry and Fuzz return to Surrey to visit collectors Nick and Hollie, who have an incredible array of cars including a 1921 Rolls-Royce Silver Ghost.

When an indoor hotel walkway collapses in Kansas City, Mo., it becomes the most deadly engineering disaster in U.S. history; experts investigate and uncover evidence of a catastrophic design change in the support system construction.

A shipping catastrophe occurs when a massive container vessel runs aground and completely blocks one of the most vital trade routes on the planet; experts investigate and uncover critical wind conditions and potential navigational errors.

A vital hillside motorway in Pennsylvania is destroyed in just minutes after a catastrophic landslide rocks a community; engineers investigate and uncover undetected geological issues with an increased and unstable traffic load.
Bruce is keen to find some World War Two objects linked to D-Day and in doing so makes an amazing discovery.
Bruce gets hold of an extremely rare, and valuable, German Panther tank, and its original undercoat is more pink than camouflage. But getting parts is a struggle.
At Biggin Hill, Bruce visits a collector's haul of WWII Spitfires. Plus, the twins prepare some WWII artillery guns to export to Australia, but it's no easy feat.

Starting out from Chicago on his ludicrous American Chopper, Henry Cole is making his way through Oklahoma on iconic Route 66; braving 90-degree heat and bouts of torrential rain and meeting plenty of colourful characters along the way.

Bruce Compton is particularly talented when it comes to knowing what sells and what doesn't. In this instance he is certain that a World War Two vehicle could make a tidy sum of £300,000.

p.d: Das Team um Dusty Crum ist auf einer Inselgruppe der Everglades unterwegs, um zu verhindern, dass sich Würgeschlangen bis auf die Florida Keys ausbreiten. Derweil stößt Brittany in Wasserproben auf eine hohe Konzentration an Tigerpython-DNA.

In Peru zieht ein heftiges Unwetter auf und im Amazonas-Regenwald schüttet es wie aus Eimern. Jetzt rächt sich, dass Amber, Trish und Jen ihren Unterschlupf nicht mit ausreichend Palmblättern abgedichtet haben. So etwas wird direkt bestraft.

p.t: Naked Survival - Ausgezogen in die Wildnis
p.d: Die hohe Luftfeuchtigkeit fördert im Kerriwong-Wald im Süden Thailands das Wachstum giftiger Pflanzen sowie zahlloser Insekten, darunter Mückenschwärme, die Dengue- und Zika-Viren übertragen.

p.t: Naked Survival - Ausgezogen in die Wildnis
p.d: Auf den Philippinen musste Skye aufgeben. Dort wurde sie wegen stechender Schmerzen und einer drohenden Infektion von Sanitätern evakuiert. Jetzt bekommt sie in Thailand eine zweite Chance.
Das Team Salvage soll eine Jacht mit gebrochenem Kiel zu einer Bootswerft schleppen.
Bei der Rettung einer Jacht bleiben die Fahrzeuge des Teams nacheinander im Schlamm stecken.
Das Team soll einen riesigen schwimmenden Ponton entfernen, der immer wieder Schwierigkeiten macht.

Im dichten Verkehrsnetz Londons geraten Kontrolleure und Ermittler täglich an ihre Grenzen. Routinekontrollen in Bus und U-Bahn eskalieren schnell, Diskussionen werden laut und nicht jeder Fahrgast bleibt kooperativ. Parallel jagt ein Team einen besonders cleveren Wiederholungstäter: Über Monate täuscht er mit seiner Oyster-Card kürzere Strecken vor und spart so regelmäßig Fahrgeld. Während die Fahnder ihm endlich auf die Spur kommen, entwickelt sich eine Kontrolle plötzlich zum Polizeieinsatz.

Während der Stoßzeit im Nahverkehr geraten die Kontrolleure mehrfach an ihre Grenzen: Eine Frau ohne gültiges Ticket weigert sich hartnäckig, ihre Personalien anzugeben, die Polizei muss eingreifen. An einem Umsteigeknoten wird ein Mann erwischt, der die Kontrolleure sogar wegstößt, um zu flüchten. Parallel verfolgen Ermittler eine junge Frau, die sich ständig Geld für angeblich nicht genutzte Fahrten zurückerstatten lässt.

Nach zwei Millionen Dollar Gewinn in drei Wochen testet Parker Schnabel nun den Claim am Sulphur Creek mit neuen Baggern. Gleichzeitig versucht Kevin Beets, Personalprobleme durch den erfahrenen Maschinenführer und Schweißer Buzz Legault zu lösen.

Parker Schnabels Karriere als Minenboss beginnt während der Schulferien. Sein Großvater John schenkt ihm Vertrauen und überträgt ihm seinen Claim. Parker muss bis zum Ende der Saison 75 Unzen Gold fördern, um den Betrieb am Laufen zu halten. Kevin Beets pachtet am Scribner Creek Land von seinem Vater Tony, um aus dessen Schatten herauszutreten. Rick Ness arbeitet als Vorarbeiter, bevor ihm die Verantwortung zufällt. Gezeigt wird, wie die drei Männer diese Herausforderungen gemeistert haben.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan this time are Dame Sheila Hancock, who discusses her stellar career, and actor Jeremy Swift to talk about 'Ted Lasso'. We also celebrate the setter, one of our favourite dog breeds, Lesley Joseph goes on safari, and we have fun with rum!

Gaby Roslin and Dr Bolu Eso are in Birmingham, celebrating the extraordinary bond between people and animals. At a specialist veterinary hospital, Bolu follows Labrador Bobbie as he undergoes pioneering laser surgery, while another dog presents the team with a neurological mystery. Gaby meets Chloe and her assistance dog Cinna and discovers how they work together, before learning about StreetVet, the charity providing free veterinary care to the pets of people experiencing homelessness.
The latest national and international news.

Alan goes traditional with a twist, creating an elegant tea-garden for a charity volunteer known as the Cake Lady - a one-woman bakery - who has made cakes for more than 9,000 injured servicemen and women. The twist is that this new garden in Birmingham will have a fully equipped kitchen to bake in, and raised beds full of fresh ingredients to add to pies and cakes. Alan creates a colourful living wall that's perfect for any gardening novice, and Katie shares the tricks to a successful balcony.

Doncaster stages the fourth day of the St Leger meeting, where the Sceptre Stakes and Mallard Handicap are the feature races, whilst at The Curragh it's the second day of Irish Champions Weekend. Morse is concerned about a murder case believed closed after the death of the accused, as a fifth victim's body is still to be accounted for. Morse is convinced that the body, that of a single woman on a day trip to Oxford, is in Wytham Woods. However, her bag was found at Blenheim Lake and when a body is discovered there, Morse and Lewis are assigned to the case.

Poirot takes a holiday at a stylish Devon hotel, only to find himself in the middle of another mystery when a guest is found murdered. Suspicion falls on the victim's husband and several other guests, and Poirot is forced to use all his powers of observation and human insight in order to solve the complex case.

It is April 1912, and news arrives of the sinking of the Titanic with the loss of Downton's heir James and his son Patrick. The Dowager Countess Violet hopes that the title and estate will pass on to the current Earl Robert's oldest daughter Mary. However, Robert decides not to name Mary his heir, and after discovering that a distant cousin is set to inherit instead, invites the young man to Downton.

Matthew Crawley and his mother Isobel arrive at Downton, and Isobel and the Dowager Countess Violet find their views clashing from the outset. Matthew has difficulty settling in to this new life, and the staff do little to ease his discomfort. Meanwhile, Carson is mortified when confronted by his past, but finds an ally in an unexpected quarter. Elsewhere, Violet attempts to promote a match between Matthew and Mary.

When Cora invites Evelyn Napier to stay at Downton, he brings along his friend Kemal Pamuk, an attaché at the Turkish Embassy. Pamuk is attracted to the eldest daughter Mary, but he later suffers a fatal heart attack in her room. Mary turns to her mother for help, but they are not the only ones who know that Pamuk was in Mary's room that night. Meanwhile, the staff find out that Housemaid Gwen is taking a correspondence course.

The fair arrives in the village and Mrs Hughes finds herself the centre of speculation when she meets a former suitor who makes her question her position at Downton. Also, Violet and Isobel are in conflict over a medical ailment affecting Molesley. Elsewhere, Carson fears there is a thief at Downton.

As the village prepares for its annual flower show, Isobel and Violet clash over Violet's long-held Best Bloom title. Meanwhile, Daisy is unable to get over what she witnessed on the night of Pamuk's death, and Mary is introduced to a potential suitor, but she thinks he is too old and stuffy - and she seems to be more interested in Matthew.

After the sudden death of his wife, a much-needed holiday for DCI Joe Mottram with his daughter Angelica is interrupted when he is called upon by his in-laws to clear the name of a relative who has been accused of murder.

A British tourist is found dead at the foot of a cliff, but did she fall or was she pushed? When Elena gives a baking lesson that makes Joe re-examine the evidence, it results in the discovery of a decisive clue that blows the case wide open.

Each year, the village of Angel's Rise hosts the Psychic Fayre. Founded by the Saint-Stephens family in memory of their late daughter, the event attracts mediums, psychics and followers of the occult. When a body is found surrounded by ritual symbols on the eve of the festival, Barnaby must step into the spiritual world to find the killer.
A giant monitor lizard, Guide Dog puppies and the bearded dragon that changed a little girl's life are just some of the remarkable stories Gaby and Dr Bolu discover in Windsor Great Park.

With only eight places available on each team, the coaches must choose carefully as they search for the UK's most exciting singing talent. And for the first time, the Rewind button gives them the chance to bring back an artist they regret letting go.

James Martin creates two great chicken dishes for Natalie Imbruglia, chef Paul Foster makes 'nduja pasta, and James Tanner cooks up a hake and king prawns Kiev. Plus, mixologist Merlin Griffiths serves up three gloriously icy summer cocktails.
The latest national and international news.

p.t: Love Your Weekend with Alan Titchmarsh
p.d: Joining Alan this time are Dame Sheila Hancock, who discusses her stellar career, and actor Jeremy Swift to talk about 'Ted Lasso'. We also celebrate the setter, one of our favourite dog breeds, Lesley Joseph goes on safari, and we have fun with rum!

Gaby Roslin and Dr Bolu Eso are in Birmingham, celebrating the extraordinary bond between people and animals. Gaby meets Chloe and her assistance dog Cinna and discovers how they work together, before learning about StreetVet, the charity providing free veterinary care to the pets of people experiencing homelessness.
The latest national and international news.

Alan creates a colourful living wall that's perfect for any gardening novice, and Katie shares the tricks to a successful balcony.

However, her bag was found at Blenheim Lake and when a body is discovered there, Morse and Lewis are assigned to the case.

Poirot takes a holiday at a stylish Devon hotel, only to find himself in the middle of another mystery when a guest is found murdered. Suspicion falls on the victim's husband and several other guests, and Poirot is forced to use all his powers of observation and human insight in order to solve the complex case.

It is April 1912, and news arrives of the sinking of the Titanic with the loss of Downton's heir James and his son Patrick. The Dowager Countess Violet hopes that the title and estate will pass on to the current Earl Robert's oldest daughter Mary. However, Robert decides not to name Mary his heir, and after discovering that a distant cousin is set to inherit instead, invites the young man to Downton.

Matthew Crawley and his mother Isobel arrive at Downton, and Isobel and the Dowager Countess Violet find their views clashing from the outset. Matthew has difficulty settling in to this new life, and the staff do little to ease his discomfort. Meanwhile, Carson is mortified when confronted by his past, but finds an ally in an unexpected quarter. Elsewhere, Violet attempts to promote a match between Matthew and Mary.

When Cora invites Evelyn Napier to stay at Downton, he brings along his friend Kemal Pamuk, an attaché at the Turkish Embassy. Pamuk is attracted to the eldest daughter Mary, but he later suffers a fatal heart attack in her room. Mary turns to her mother for help, but they are not the only ones who know that Pamuk was in Mary's room that night. Meanwhile, the staff find out that Housemaid Gwen is taking a correspondence course.

The fair arrives in the village and Mrs Hughes finds herself the centre of speculation when she meets a former suitor who makes her question her position at Downton. Also, Violet and Isobel are in conflict over a medical ailment affecting Molesley. Elsewhere, Carson fears there is a thief at Downton.

As the village prepares for its annual flower show, Isobel and Violet clash over Violet's long-held Best Bloom title. Meanwhile, Daisy is unable to get over what she witnessed on the night of Pamuk's death, and Mary is introduced to a potential suitor, but she thinks he is too old and stuffy - and she seems to be more interested in Matthew.

After the sudden death of his wife, a much-needed holiday for DCI Joe Mottram with his daughter Angelica is interrupted when he is called upon by his in-laws to clear the name of a relative who has been accused of murder.

A British tourist is found dead at the foot of a cliff, but did she fall or was she pushed? When Elena gives a baking lesson that makes Joe re-examine the evidence, it results in the discovery of a decisive clue that blows the case wide open.

p.t: Boss Shark: Battle of the Sexes

Not everyone in Sri Lanka's monkey paradise is equal. Anna sits at the bottom of the social ladder and with a newborn baby, life is getting tougher. As drought grips the region and tensions boil over, can she do enough to keep her son alive?

Troop life is full of fun and adventure for teenage macaques, but it can't stay that way forever. When males come of age, they're forced out of the group. Follow young Ravi as he leaves his idyllic home and sets off on the journey of a lifetime.

Tufted grey langurs share their territory with a troop of toque macaques and a group of purple face leaf monkeys. This is primate paradise. But a crippling drought changes everything. The three species are forced to adapt and take risks.

In the summer months, the Arctic comes to life and impresses with its breathtaking beauty. A summer in Alaska shows the wonderful landscapes of the northernmost US state and shows the symbiosis between water, plants and animals.

Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

Predators are born to kill. These specialised hunters with impressive weapons and unique attack strategies must kill to survive, but the harsh reality of life as a hunter is never knowing where your next meal is coming from.
Snakes, Spiders and Scorpions, these creepy crawlies are the animals people connect with least and fear most. They have some of the most venomous creatures in the world within their ranks.
Visit medieval castles in Romania and France where bears, lynx and falcons are making a comeback, then check out a rock lizard that's thriving in the Pyrenees.

Volcanoes erupt globally every day, with immense destructive potential; detailed footage and survival tales provide insight into their monstrous power, from Mount St. Helens in 1980 to the 2018 eruption of Volcan de Fuego.

A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión.
